# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

_crawl.linkedin_about: We are accelerating the world's transformation to sustainable materials, by replacing fossil fuel sources with plants. We believe that all products should be responsibly sourced, traceable, and transparent — the sustainable source™. At Geno, we are breaking the planet's reliance on these fossil fuels by creating something better. Our vision to drive climate action at scale starts by making the same molecules, ingredients, and materials we rely on every day, but deriving them from more sustainable sources. Our technology and capabilities, developed and honed over two decades, harness the ever-increasing power of biotechnology, where microorganisms and industrial processes are designed to ferment plant sugars into materials and ingredients. Geno's Innovation Center is home to our world-class research and development team of engineers and scientists who have deployed more than $300 million in technology investment, collaborating to create a portfolio of 2,200 patents and applications. The IP covers product pathways, synthetic biology approaches to engineering microorganisms, processes to bio-manufacture products, their sometimes unique biological compositions, and product applications. We work closely with some of the world’s leading brands to develop solutions that align superior performance and economics with sustainability. We also produce and market our own branded products and license our geno technology to some of the world’s largest manufacturers including Novamont, Qore® (a joint venture of Cargill and HELM), Covestro, and Aquafil. ## Capturing Carbon. Fueling the Future.

At LanzaTech, we’re turning waste carbon into new beginnings.

Using our proprietary bio-fermentation technology, we transform industrial emissions, carbon
dioxide, and gasified waste into **ethanol**—a building block for a wide range of sustainable
products, including **Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF)** and other critical chemical derivatives.

With **six commercial facilities** already in operation and more on the way, we’re scaling fast to
meet the world’s growing demand for fuels and materials. Our technology helps industrial sectors by
unlocking value from emissions that would otherwise go to waste.

Together with our partners, we’re building a **circular carbon economy**—where carbon is
continuously reused, not released.

[Learn more][26]

## CARBON CAPTURE & UTILIZATION

We partner with energy-intensive industries to capture and process carbon-rich gases before they
enter the atmosphere. We then give that carbon a second life by partnering with suppliers and brands
to integrate recycled carbon into their supply chains to make new products and materials.

What was once a vision is now delivering measurable results across heavy industry. Our technology is
enhancing energy security, building resilient operations worldwide, and—together with our
partners—reinforcing critical supply chains. 

## Leadership

## Dr. Jennifer Holmgren

## /

## CEO

Jennifer is the Chief Executive Officer of LanzaTech. Jennifer has over 20 years of experience in
the energy sector including a proven track record in the development and commercialization of fuels
and chemicals technologies.


## THE PROCESS

LanzaTech is changing how people think about carbon by creating opportunities to create value from
waste

## Environmental Impact

Life cycle analysis (LCA) is essential for understanding the environmental benefits of LanzaTech’s
technology. LanzaTech has developed in-house LCA expertise and engages in collaborations to
understand and develop recommendations for methodological approaches which vary by region. We
regularly work with specialists around the world including: The European Commission (EC)/ Joint
Research Council (JRC), Roundtable for Sustainable Biomaterials (RSB), International Civil Aviation
Organization (ICAO), International Sustainability & Carbon Certification (ISCC), California Air
Resources Board (CARB), Argonne National Laboratory (ANL), Michigan Technological University (MTU),
Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and others.

LCAs consider the impacts of producing and using all energy and chemical inputs into the final
product(s). Third party analyses are used wherever possible and are available to our customers. We
also conduct LCAs for peer review, using in-house engineering data and emission factors from
appropriate published LCA-specific databases and third-party market projections.

[Here you can find an example][27] of a peer reviewed LCA for carbon negative chemicals production,
published in [Nature Biotechnology.][28]

[Here is an example][29] of a third party LCA for high purity ethanol which includes transportation
to Europe. As more facilities using our technology come online globally, the impact of
transportation on the LCA will be greatly reduced. LanzaTech continues to conduct LCAs on each
facility, exploring different methodologies and parameters. We are currently completing an internal
review of an LCA of the same facility for fuel grade ethanol to the factory gate. This will be
published after it has been reviewed by a third party. Current estimates of the resulting LCA show a
significant reduction relative to high purity ethanol being shipped to Europe.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Our way of life is built on carbon, from our fuel sources to the materials in our consumer products, but we need a more sustainable way to source it to protect the future of our planet. LanzaTech Global, Inc. is the carbon recycling company transforming waste carbon into sustainable raw materials for everyday products. Using its biorecycling technology, LanzaTech captures carbon-rich gases generated by energy-intensive industries at the source, preventing them from being emitted into the air. LanzaTech then gives that captured carbon a new life as a sustainable replacement for virgin fossil carbon in everything from household cleaners and clothing fibers to packaging and fuels. By partnering with companies across the global supply chain like ArcelorMittal, Zara, H&M Move and Coty, LanzaTech is paving the way for a circular carbon economy.

relevant_companies.company_summary: MGP Ingredients is a leading U.S. supplier of premium distilled spirits, including gins, vodkas, and bourbon and rye whiskeys, backed by over 150 years of expertise. In addition to its spirits, the company is the largest producer of specialty non-GMO wheat proteins and starches, which offer functional, nutritional, and sensory benefits for various food applications. Headquartered in Atchison, Kansas, with a distillation facility in Lawrenceburg, Indiana, MGP is committed to enhancing food quality and flavor through its innovative products.

Established in Houston, Texas, USA, Bisley International draws on the global reach of the
multinational Bisley Group, with 65 years of experience in marketing and as distributor of chemical
products and high quality industrial raw materials throughout Asia Pacific, Oceania and the Middle
East.

# Raw Materials Supplier USA

Bisley International deploys a holistic understanding of markets, technical insight and logistics
excellence to build durable strategies which unite the world’s best raw material producers with
industrial consumers in North America. We supply and distribute a wide range of specialty chemicals,
minerals, raw materials and more...

[About Us][55] [View Products][56]

WHAT WE DO

## Industry experts & the trusted chemical raw material supplier in the USA & Worldwide

Established in Houston, Texas, USA, Bisley International draws on the global reach of the
multinational Bisley Group, with 65 years of experience in marketing and as distributor of chemical
products and high quality industrial raw materials throughout Asia Pacific, Oceania and the Middle
East.

[Contact Sales][57] [Visit Bisley Group Australia][58]

As international raw materials and chemical suppliers, our products range from Fine Industrial
Chemicals for highly specialised applications, to bulk raw materials delivered in shiploads to major
regional manufacturers.

Our goal is to provide a complete package of technically outstanding products, supported by
proficient, responsive staff and first class logistics to a range of industries.

**Our Value Proposition**
We pride ourselves in our ability to add value and create synergies for our supplier and customer
partners.

**Our Guarantees**
We believe it’s important to focus on what is most valuable to our customers and really stand by
this - for the long term.

**Our strategic network…**
Our experienced team of logistics experts are able to track our cargo movements from factories
across the globe right to our customer’s doorstep, whilst keeping all stakeholders informed with up
to date information.

Bisley International is supported by the Bisley Group, with headquarters in Sydney, Australia.
Global chemical sourcing is also supported through our network of offices in the UAE, Bangkok,
Singapore, Malaysia, New Zealand, Indonesia and USA.

# Bio-Solutions For a
# Greener Tomorrow

### ***GEMTEK** Products* formulates and manufactures industrial cleaners, degreasers, solvents and
### specialty chemicals derived from renewable, biobased resources.

As a pioneer in the biobased industry, **GEMTEK** Products remains steadfast in its commitment to
the research, development, and manufacturing of non-toxic, environmentally safe cleaners,
degreasers, solvents, and specialty chemicals. Since 1992, **GEMTEK** has played a key role in the
global transition away from petroleum- and synthetic-based chemistries toward sustainable,
plant-based alternatives. By combining advanced green chemistry with performance standards, the
company has consistently delivered products that meet the demand of industrial, commercial, and
institutional users without compromising environmental integrity or worker safety.

Over the past three decades, **GEMTEK** has built a reputation for innovation, reliability, and
regulatory leadership, helping organizations reduce hazardous waste, lower VOC emissions, and
support safer workplace practices. Through a strong focus on sustainability, compliance, and
customer-driven innovation, **GEMTEK** continues to shape the future of worldwide environmental
responsibility.

### In keeping with the company’s mission statement…

### “Safely Cleaning Planet Earth”, **GEMTEK** is committed to providing its customers with a value
### – high quality products at a competitive price.

**GEMTEK** believes that superior cleaning and industrial performance should never come at the
expense of human health, workplace safety, or environmental sustainability. For this reason,
**GEMTEK** maintains a strict commitment to formulating products without the use of toxic,
hazardous, or environmentally damaging chemistries commonly found in traditional petroleum- and
synthetic-based solutions.  This commitment enables customers to achieve operational efficiency and
dependable performance without compromising their sustainability goals.

The company’s mission extends beyond product manufacturing; it reflects a broader dedication to
responsible stewardship, continuous innovation, and long-term environmental accountability. By
prioritizing safety, performance, and environmental responsibility in every aspect of its business,
**GEMTEK** continues to uphold its vision of “Safely Cleaning Planet Earth” for current and future

### ***GEMTEK** Products* formulates and manufactures industrial cleaners, degreasers, solvents and
### specialty chemicals derived from renewable, biobased resources.

As a pioneer in the biobased industry, **GEMTEK** Products remains steadfast in its commitment to
the research, development, and manufacturing of non-toxic, environmentally safe cleaners,
degreasers, solvents, and specialty chemicals. Since 1992, **GEMTEK** has played a key role in the
global transition away from petroleum- and synthetic-based chemistries toward sustainable,
plant-based alternatives. By combining advanced green chemistry with performance standards, the
company has consistently delivered products that meet the demand of industrial, commercial, and
institutional users without compromising environmental integrity or worker safety.

Over the past three decades, **GEMTEK** has built a reputation for innovation, reliability, and
regulatory leadership, helping organizations reduce hazardous waste, lower VOC emissions, and
support safer workplace practices. Through a strong focus on sustainability, compliance, and
customer-driven innovation, **GEMTEK** continues to shape the future of worldwide environmental
responsibility.

synthetic-based solutions.  This commitment enables customers to achieve operational efficiency and

The company’s mission extends beyond product manufacturing; it reflects a broader dedication to

What We Do

## We make fuel from waste.
## Not as a compromise — as an upgrade.

Greenjoules is a deep-tech biorefinery operating from Chakan, Pune. We take agri-waste and
agro-industrial residues — materials that would otherwise be burned in open fields — and convert
them through a proprietary thermochemical process into second-generation biofuels that are
chemically indistinguishable from their fossil counterparts.

The critical difference: our fuels carry among the lowest lifecycle carbon footprints of any fuel
available anywhere in the world today. And unlike first-generation biofuels, not a single food crop
is diverted.

🌾

#### Zero food vs. fuel conflict

Agricultural residues only — rice husk, sugarcane press mud, paddy straw. No cropland diverted. No
food chain disrupted.

🔬

#### Proprietary process technology

Our thermochemical conversion process is developed and owned entirely by our team. No licensed IP,
no royalty dependency — full technical control at every step.

⛽

#### True drop-in replacement

Meets BIS:1460 (Indian diesel standard). Surpasses Euro VI. No engine or infrastructure modification
required — it simply replaces fossil diesel, litre for litre.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Incorporated in 1994, Resil was one of the first companies to begin a process of transformation by exploring the power of silicone to provide distinct finishes for the fabric and apparel industry. Today, Resil is one of Asia's largest innovative formulator of silicone for textiles and has expanded its product range to cover finishing, pretreatment and specialty processes. Accompanied by vast application and industry experience, the company enjoys consultant status in textile finishing. Marketing alliances with other world leaders in multiple finishing technologies has empowered the company to introduce global standards to textiles. Besides a nationwide presence in India, Resil also serves key markets around the world. Resil has strong presence in silicone for various industries like Agriculture, Personal care and Pharmaceutical applications. Resil has new antimicrobial technologies based on Micro and Nano Silver for various Industrial applications. Advanced Functional Materials for various specialty applications can be provided on request.

Rossari Biotech Limited is one of India's largest specialty chemical manufacturers, delivering
high-performance solutions that touch billions of lives daily. With over four decades of experience,
the company offers 4,300+ products to 3,000+ customers across 65+ countries. Operating seven
manufacturing facilities with 332,000+ MTPA capacity, Rossari Biotech serves diverse industries
including Textiles, Home Personal Care and Performance Chemicals, and Animal Health and Nutrition.
The company leads the market across four core chemistries: surfactants, polymers, silicones, and
enzymes. Committed to sustainability through green chemistry and zero-liquid-discharge facilities,
Rossari Biotech leverages its strong foundation and experienced leadership to shape the future of
specialty chemistry, creating lasting value for stakeholders worldwide.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Rossari Biotech Limited touches the lives of billions daily, delivering value as one of India’s largest specialty chemical manufacturers. With 45+ years of cumulative experience, we offer a diversified portfolio of 4,300+ products, serving 3,000+ customers across 65+ countries. Our operations are supported by seven strategically located manufacturing facilities with an installed capacity of 332,000+ MTPA, complemented by best-in-class R&D infrastructure and a highly skilled technical workforce. Serving a broad spectrum of industries across Home and Personal Care, Performance Chemicals, Textile Specialty Chemicals, and Animal Health and Nutrition, Rossari Biotech Limited continues to provide sustainable value for customers, partners, communities, and stakeholders worldwide. Our market leadership is maintained across four core pillars of chemistry: surfactants, polymers, silicones, and enzymes, supported by advanced R&D expertise. _crawl.linkedin_about: SAEL Industries Limited, is a leading Indian renewable energy company specializing in solar and waste-to-energy projects, committed to fostering green assets that contribute to the global transition toward sustainable energy. At the forefront of the fight against climate change, SAEL provides decarbonization solutions through its renewable projects across India. Our vision is to pioneer India’s energy landscape by producing sustainable and affordable energy in a responsible manner. Over the years, SAEL has developed a renewable portfolio of 6,918 MW with a committed EBITDA of INR 2700 crores from IPP business. Today, it proudly stands as India’s largest waste-to-energy producer, utilizing state-of-the-art European technology. The company operates over 20 solar projects across multiple states, including Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, Mizoram, and Punjab, spanning more than 50 sites. Additionally, SAEL has established module manufacturing plants with a capacity of 2,300 MW, which is being expanded to 3,400 MW in Rajasthan and Punjab, demonstrating its commitment to backward integration and supporting the "Make in India" initiative. SAEL's dedication to solar and waste-to-energy projects aligns seamlessly with India’s vision of harnessing clean, green energy sources. The company's core values reflect its sustained efforts to create positive environmental impact and drive sustainable development within the energy sector.

_crawl.linkedin_about: “Excellence in all Things – technical competence, international quality with consistency and respect to environment - centered on absolute customer delight” has been the core business strategy over the years for Sarex. SAREX CHEMICALS is a chemicals manufacturing company, catering to the textile industry for more than 50 years. Incorporated as SUPERTEX (India) Corporation, the company has grown to become a global player, which is an Indian multinational and one of the renowned export houses of specialty textile chemicals. To meet the ever-evolving, technological and marketing demands of new century, Sarex has set a new, state-of-art manufacturing facility at Tarapur, Mumbai (India). We are also an ISO 9001:2008, ISO 14001:2004, OHSAS 18001:2007 company certified by URS (United Registrar of Sustems, UK. Our products are certified for GOTS and REACH compliant with all Eco-label norms. Sarex nurtures core values such as their commitment to safety, and environmental stewardship, to excellence in their manufacture of quality products and outstanding customer service. Sarex offers a conducive atmosphere for the career growth of their highly skilled and talented people, who being highly motivated are involved in development and manufacture of the International level quality products that help make life better for consumers in a multitude of ways. Sarex is a Government recognized star export house, exporting their products to more than 40 countries worldwide. Apart from America, Mexico, Europe, Asia and Middle East, Sarex exports to South American countries like Argentina, Brazil, Peru, Colombia, Guatemala, Honduras, etc. The products can be offered as is and in a concentrated form which can be diluted at customer’s end to make ready- to- use formulations. In line with our quest for excellence, Sarex has a state of the art Technical Service Laboratory (T.S.L.) at Tarapur, (Mumbai) India.

### Experience. Transformation.

Beginning with the inspiring legacy of Lorilleux and Samuel Morrill in the early 1800’s, Sun

ongoing commitment to quality and service for our customers.

A member of the DIC Group, Sun Chemical is a leading producer of packaging and graphic solutions,
color and display technologies, functional products, electronic materials, and products for the
automotive and healthcare industries.

Together with DIC, Sun Chemical’s 21,000+ employees are continuously working to promote and develop

## Sun Chemical's Products and Solutions

#### [ Packaging and Graphic Solutions ][116]

Sun Chemical is a recognized leader in[ printing inks, coatings, adhesives and supplies][117] for
the packaging, publication, commercial, industrial, and digital markets and introduces solutions
that enable marketers to better manage their brand colors, protect product integrity through
improvements in packaging, and introduce security features that defend against counterfeiting.

#### [ Color Materials ][118]

Sun Chemical develops a wide range of [pigments and color materials][119] for architectural,
automotive and industrial coatings, cosmetics, plastics, printing inks, agricultural, and more.
Combining its pigments with DIC’s polymers for the same industries can create superior benefits and
value for coatings formulators.

#### [ Advanced Materials ][120]

Sun Chemical and DIC produce a variety of [advanced materials][121], including liquid compounds,
solid compounds and application materials for printed circuits, printed electronics, solar modules,
digital inkjet printing, automotive components, adhesives, magnetic tapes for plastic cards and
degasification modules.

#### [ Sun Chemical Security ][122]

[Sun Chemical Security][123] is our dedicated global security solutions business unit focused on
providing a wide-range of high-quality security solutions to help protect your products from
counterfeiters.

## Sun Chemical's Unwavering Focus on Sustainability

#### Learn How Sun Chemical is Prioritizing Sustainability

Sun Chemical is constantly working to promote sustainable solutions. [Our approach][124] to
sustainability guides the way we develop, manufacture and distribute products, as well as how we
work with our customers and suppliers.

Working with industry leaders and in line with DIC Corporation’s goal to achieve [carbon neutrality
by 2050][125], we are reducing global CO2 emissions by increasing the use of bio-renewable and
recyclable materials, while promoting the value of these activities throughout the supply chain. Our

## Economic Bioplastic to Finally beat Petrochemical Plastic.

At Sustainable Chemicals™, we are bringing novel bioplastics materials to market that will
revolutionize how bioplastics are adopted and used. Our ambitious goal is backed by economics and
superior performance, existing bioplastics can’t match, and will enable us to bring sustainable
bioplastics to producers and consumers in the plastics industry.

## **OUR MISSION IS TO SOLVE THE PLASTIC PROBLEM
## **

> *″Bioplastics have been around for decades, but the technology remains limited to niche
> applications because they have inferior properties and are more expensive than traditional
> plastics. The only way to achieve meaningful environmental change is to design a bioplastic that
> is cost and performance competitive with petroleum-based plastics. That is why I founded
> Sustainable Chemicals™.″*
> 
> **
> 
> * – Silvia Luebben, Sust-Chem CEO and Founder*
> 
> **
> 
> **
> 
> **

### Novel BioPlastics

We have novel bioplastics platform made from raw material obtained from biomass. This reduces the
carbon footprint of our product by 45% compared to petrochemical plastics.

### BioDegradation

If dispersed in the environment, Sust-Chem’s bioplastics degrade into benign molecules that can be
used by nature as building blocks.

If collected, our biopolymers can be chemically recycled.

### Cost-competitive

Petrochemical plastics are ubiquitous because they are convenient and cheap. Our chemistry does not
require fermentation compared to other bioplastics, which allows us to scale economically and become
cost-competitive with the petrochemical plastics.

### Actual Plastic Properties

Existing bioplastic products do not have a plastic look, feel, or application. Our bioplastics are
designed to have properties that match conventional petrochemical plastics to provide diverse
product applications.

## We Have the Power to Impact Our Future, and We’re Doing Something About It

 We are drowning in plastic pollution. 
* By the year 2050 there will be more plastic in the ocean than fish .
* Non-biodegradable plastics breakdown into smaller fragments, called microplastics, which enter our
  drinking water and food supply.  Each person consumes about half a pound of microplastics per
  year.
* Plastic manufacture and incineration accounts for 13% of global carbon dioxide emissions, a
  leading cause of global warming.
* Only 9% of plastic is actually recycled.
* Current alternatives to conventional polymers have made great technological advances, however
  their used is limited to niche applications because their cost is higher and their performance in
  inferior to that of conventional fossil fuel based plastics.

## OUR DUTY

## Bring to market a family of sustainable bioplastics that compete with petrochemical plastics in
## price and performance. 

## BIODEGRADABLE

Our material has a benign end of life whether it is recycled, up-cycled or lost to the environment.

[Learn More][6]

## RENEWABLE

The monomer is sourced from biomass which allows us to reduce the carbon footprint of our plastics
by 45%.

[Learn More][7]

## NONPERSISTANT

Our plastic breaks down into benign materials if improperly disposed.

[Learn More][8]

## NONTOXIC

The monomer is present in soy sauce and has a natural metabolic pathway.

[Learn More][9]

## PROPERTIES

Mechanical properties of our biopolymer match conventional plastics.

[Learn More][10]

## Get In Touch

_crawl.linkedin_about: SUSTCHEM TECHNICAL CONSULTING S.A. was founded in 2007 by the Chemical Engineers Panagiotis Braimiotis and Panos Scarlatos. The vision of the founders is to provide complete and integrated services to enterprises towards the challenge of sustainable growth in the globalized environment and to develop the culture of a complete and designed handling of challenges, according to each customer’s demands and special characteristics. SUSTCHEM S.A. covers a wide range of services both in Greece and abroad, concerning both the establishment and operation of a business and the marketing of its products. With significant knowledge and experience in plant design, environmental studies, BAT, in preventing major accidents, has expanded its services to energy saving and certification management systems such as ISO 50001. It provides organized chemical services that satisfy both the horizontal requirements of the REACH/ CLP Regulations and all associated legislation, as well as the requirements for the marketing of products such as cleaners, biocides, plant protection products, fertilizers, electronic cigarettes, pharmaceuticals, biofuels, medical devices and other products. It supports companies as for the certification of their products with CE, EcoLabel, Carbon Neutral Footprint & Water Footprint, promoting business efforts in the conctantly changing market demands. SUSTCHEM S.A. is certified with ISO 9001: 2015 and ISO 14001: 2015 management systems, is licensed as external protection and prevention service company and is registered in the Energy Services Register (ESCO). It is a member of the Hellenic Association Chemical Industries (HACI) and has adopted the Responsible Care initiative.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Trillium Renewable Chemicals is developing a chemical process technology for the manufacture of acrylonitrile and acetonitrile from renewable feedstocks (e.g. glycerol). Acrylonitrile is a valuable intermediate used in the production of a wide range of molecules, e.g.: acrylic fibers, carbon fibers, specialty amines, nylon, adiponitrile, styrene acrylonitrile resin, acrylonitrile butadiene styrene, nitrile rubbers, and acrylamide. By making a green, drop-in replacement precursor, Trillium helps customers reach sustainability goals. These drop-in replacement molecules have a wide range of applications with strong sustainability drivers, e.g.: apparel, automotive parts, toys, sporting goods, household furnishings, and water treatment.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Established in 1989, Vinati Organics Limited (VOL) is a specialty chemical company, focusing on manufacturing specialty chemicals and organic intermediaries. We combine innovation with chemistry to deliver value-added products to our customers. We follow the highest quality standards and our products meet diverse customer expectations. At Vinati Organics Limited, we have two plants, both situated in Maharashtra at Mahad (Raigad) and Lote Parashuram (Ratnagiri). Our plants are ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and OHSAS 18001:2007 certified for following quality control, environment & health and safety standards. We are world leaders in two of our main products, Isobutyl Benzene (IBB) and 2-Acrylamido 2 Methylpropane Sulfonic Acid (ATBS). We export our products to more than 35 countries and our customers are present across the US, South America, Europe and Asia.

_crawl.linkedin_about: SUPCON is a global technology company that provides process automation and digitalization product, solution and service. Adhering to a shared mission of Make Industry Smarter, Make Life Easier, SUPCON is committed to continuous improvement in industry development and human well-being. SUPCON AI-POETTM 5T strategy leverages domain expertise of AT (Automation Technology), IT (Information Technology), PT (Process Technology), OT (Operation Technology), ET (Equipment Technology), and brings a 3-level product/solution portfolio - plant operating system+APP, control system and field instrumentation to comprehensively empower process industries to be more safe, green and sustainable, especially for Oil & Gas, Chemical, Power, Building Material, Pulp & Paper, Metallurgy,Life science, Food & Beverage, Utilities, etc. To help clients win digital transformation campaign, improve plant performance in a sustainable manner, and drive the circular economy wheel, SUPCON launched dOps Digital Monitoring and Optimization Operating System. It is designed as a comprehensive solution applying a highly open and scalable plant operating system+APP architecture to integrate all the data silos and unlock immense value by leveraging the integrated data in wide applications around operation management, supply chain management, asset management, safety & security management, energy management under the development background, etc. It takes the basic approach “think big, start small, scale fast” and allows agile development without disrupting the entire application. For the classic automation pyramid, SUPCON offers a wide portfolio of products including DCS, SIS, PLC, intelligent transmitter, flowmeter, control valve, industrial analyzer, etc. An ISO 9001 Certified company ,Operating in India Since 2005 have Factory cum Office Setup in Bangalore, which is known as SUPCON Global Engineering Service Center Nepal, having branches in Vadodara ,Noida ,Kolkata ,Pune,Chennai,Vizag and etc .

relevant_companies.company_summary: GMP Group Ltd., established in 1948 in Izmir, specializes in the distribution and manufacturing of textile raw materials and cleaning products, notably under the Prens detergent brand. With a diverse product range that includes dishwashing liquids and personal care items, the company has expanded its operations to serve both domestic and international markets, achieving significant export success since 2001. Operating from a modern facility in Torbalı, GMP Group is committed to quality and innovation, utilizing advanced technology to meet customer expectations and enhance its position as a leading producer in Turkey and beyond.

_crawl.linkedin_about: GMP Group Ltd. was established in Izmir primarily to distribute and sale textile raw materials to domestic market in 1948. Our commercial activities related with marketing of durable consumer goods under Prens detergent brand have begun in 1984. After the decision of passing to manufacturing goods production, dishwashing liquid detergent’s production has begun in 1991 which made it our first category of products among the further. The product range becomes richer every day so as to enhance the capabilities of the cleaning and personal care products with its contents and different designs and to meet customer expectations with different solutions in cleaning. As GMP group has been still engaging in various fields including textile, cleaning, cosmetics, personal care products and distribution under the leadership of the third generation, our export history has begun in 2001 with Prens products which is the flagship in our group. Prens products have been manufactured with a modern understanding in the production facilities located over an area of 15.000 m2 in Torbalı since 2009. _crawl.linkedin_about: SimulateLive.com is a professional portal for the promotion of process modeling, simulation and related engineering disciplines with the aim to serve process industry. SimulateLive.com is covering: • Process simulation: steady state and dynamic simulation, • Operator training simulators, • Process design and optimization, • Advanced process control and real time optimization, • Process analysis and monitoring. Because process simulation has become one of the most important disciplines of process industry with globally growing market, the aim of this portal is to bring it closer to engineers and industry, connect the vendors and the community it is serving via the web-site, e-newsletters, social networking, written and video lessons, product reviews, events and other digital media offerings.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Borealis Hotel Group (“Borealis”), founded in 1997 and headquartered in Amsterdam, is a fast-expanding European hospitality company. The group, backed by strong institutional investors, is led and supported by a passionate team with an extensive track-record. After selling its former portfolio end 2015, Borealis started building todays portfolio and now operates and owns hotels in the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany, Austria, Spain and Denmark, all branded by international hotel chains like Accor, Hilton, IHG, and Marriott. Borealis has been and is a solid partner for investors, family offices and the likes. Next to its secured pipeline of additional hotels across continental Europe the group’s ambition is to continue and accelerate its growth by initiating new hotel projects, conversions of existing assets as well as portfolio add-ons to its platform.

# Together we can do even better chemistry.

## Green Chemical Design - How to meet an urgent industry need

### Purpose

To be a leader in the response to the demand for a fully sustainable chemicals industry, by helping
to introduce new solutions to serious needs for substitution of hazardous substances, and
development of new green chemistry

### Business Model

To participate in and facilitate multidisciplinary teams involving all stakeholders in the
development of new products. This includes business leaders and scientists. We have the team players
needed to deliver new strategies for `safe and sustainable by design` chemistry.

### Principles

Our innovations fully-recognise green chemistry principles, and our work is not driven by profit but
by the need for change towards a sustainable industry. The challenges require broad knowledge of all
aspects of the industry and the use of the necessary skills, from computational chemistry, hazard,
risk, engineering, and more.

### Impact

To help facilitate the reduction in the use of hazardous substances by the optimal use of those
substances that are already well-understood and by innovation. The long-term viability of the
chemical industry depends on its regeneration in a cost-effective way.

## Value Proposition

We provide value in our technical strengths and understanding the strategy for development of new
commercially-viable approaches.

see the [Business Context][14]

**New chemicals come from**
* **novel ideas** on how to substitute and avoid use of toxic substances
* techniques for the **simultaneous** consideration of the desired performance of a product and its
  hazard or risk
* the use of highly **biodegradable** substances
* essential **R&D** and **regulatory experience**
* use of **risk characterisation** as part of the comparison of alternatives

Concepts such as ‘safe and sustainable by design’, ‘safe by design’, ‘functional substitution’, ‘eco
innovation’, ‘sustainable chemistry’, ‘green chemistry’ etc are all implied by this proposition.

Regulatory compliance services are not provided by GCD; we recommend [Peter Fisk Associates
Limited][15] for top-quality consultancy

# Together we can do even better chemistry.

## Green Chemical Design - How to meet an urgent industry need

### Purpose

To be a leader in the response to the demand for a fully sustainable chemicals industry, by helping
to introduce new solutions to serious needs for substitution of hazardous substances, and
development of new green chemistry

### Business Model

To participate in and facilitate multidisciplinary teams involving all stakeholders in the
development of new products. This includes business leaders and scientists. We have the team players
needed to deliver new strategies for `safe and sustainable by design` chemistry.

### Principles

Our innovations fully-recognise green chemistry principles, and our work is not driven by profit but
by the need for change towards a sustainable industry. The challenges require broad knowledge of all
aspects of the industry and the use of the necessary skills, from computational chemistry, hazard,
risk, engineering, and more.

### Impact

To help facilitate the reduction in the use of hazardous substances by the optimal use of those
substances that are already well-understood and by innovation. The long-term viability of the
chemical industry depends on its regeneration in a cost-effective way.

## Value Proposition

We provide value in our technical strengths and understanding the strategy for development of new
commercially-viable approaches.

see the [Business Context][14]

**New chemicals come from**
* **novel ideas** on how to substitute and avoid use of toxic substances
* techniques for the **simultaneous** consideration of the desired performance of a product and its
  hazard or risk
* the use of highly **biodegradable** substances
* essential **R&D** and **regulatory experience**
* use of **risk characterisation** as part of the comparison of alternatives

Concepts such as ‘safe and sustainable by design’, ‘safe by design’, ‘functional substitution’, ‘eco
innovation’, ‘sustainable chemistry’, ‘green chemistry’ etc are all implied by this proposition.

Regulatory compliance services are not provided by GCD; we recommend [Peter Fisk Associates
Limited][15] for top-quality consultancy

_crawl.linkedin_about: Brenntag is the global market leader in chemicals and ingredients distribution and holds a central role in connecting customers and suppliers of the chemical industry. Headquartered in Essen, Germany, we have more than 18,100 employees worldwide and operate a network of around 600 sites in more than 70 countries. In 2024, the company generated sales of €16.2 billion. The two global divisions, Brenntag Essentials and Brenntag Specialties, provide a diversified and broad portfolio of industrial and specialty chemicals and ingredients as well as tailor-made application, marketing and supply chain solutions, technical and formulation support, comprehensive regulatory know-how and digital solutions for a wide range of industries. Brenntag pursues an ambitious sustainability agenda and is committed to sustainable solutions in its own sector and the industries served. Brenntag SE shares have been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2010 and have been part of the DAX since September 2021. In addition, the Brenntag SE shares are listed in the DAX 30 ESG and DAX ESG Target.

**Eric McAfee** – Founder/Chairman/CEO of Aemetis, Inc.

## For SAF’s Take-off, look to India’s policies

“The India government has now mandated that the three large companies that own 70% of the oil
refineries in India must purchase biodiesel on a “Cost Plus“ basis… The airline industry should do
the same in order to rapidly grow the production of sustainable aviation fuel in order to
decarbonize aviation… The actual problem we have is that we are not serious about the adoption of
renewable fuels. That is a political problem, not an industry problem.”

[Read Article][18]

## On June 10th 2022, Aemetis hosted a Ribbon Cutting Ceremony for the Aemetis Biogas Central Dairy
## Digester Project at our Keyes Advanced Fuels Facility.

[See the Event Page][19]

**Valerie Sarisky-Reed**, Director, Bioenergy Technologies Office – U.S. Department of Energy

## Ethanol vs. Petroleum-Based Fuel Carbon Emissions

“Biofuels have been proven to emit significantly lower greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions than
petroleum-based fuels, and recent scientific studies indicate that net-zero emission biofuels are
not only possible, but achievable.”

[Read Article][20]

# Paint the future with AkzoNobel

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

## Creating a world-leading coatings company

AkzoNobel and Axalta have announced an all-stock merger of equals, brining together two iconic
industry leaders.

[ Deal overview ][51] [ Read media release ][52]

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

### Why Now?

[ PBS 2024 Watch Full Episode ][3]

Eighteen years of R&D reached commercial maturity in 2024. We achieved direct margin positive
manufacturing—not in a pilot, but at commercial scale across multiple facilities.

The industry's first new mycelium crop in 400 years is now in production. It turns faster than any
plant-based alternative on shelf.

Consumer demand for clean-label whole foods is accelerating precisely as our economics crossed the
profitability threshold.

The AirMycelium™ platform integrates directly with existing mushroom farming infrastructure,
unlocking 450 million square meters of global capacity already built, already operating.

We scale quickly and capital light. Over five years we've proven technology transfer works: contract
growers reach target yields within months.

Twenty years of accumulated knowhow and forty patents protect our process. But the strongest moat is
operational excellence—cultivated across strain optimization, new technology development, and
feedstock-to-food transformation at multi-million pound scale.

Now

### We Grow [Food]

[Chef Nick cooking MyBacon]

#### Farmed. Not Fake.

That thesis is on shelf today.

We transform wildtype gourmet mycelium into whole, sliceable meat alternatives grown indoors.

Unlike extruded protein isolates formed into shapes, mycelium delivers natural whole-cut texture in
large, sliced strips—ready to cook like traditional meat.

Indoor cultivation keeps environmental impact low while enabling year-round production.

The result is a versatile protein, rich in fiber, that consumers actually buy twice.

**MyBacon** is whole slices of meaty mycelium, brined using our signature recipe, ready to heat and
serve.

#### Velocity:

MyBacon is the fastest-selling vegan bacon in the natural channel, with roughly 2× category velocity
per SPINS.

#### Distribution:

Now in 3,000+ stores nationwide, with distribution across all 50 states, including Whole Foods,
Giant, Hannaford, Natural Grocers, Schnucks, Gelson's.

#### Economics:

Unit costs dropped 65% year-over-year. We reached direct margin positive in 2025. We price against
premium products.

Scale, strain optimization, and operational discipline provide a multi-decade pipeline to maximally
competitive cost position globally.

[Explore MyForest Foods →][4]

### Our Mission: Growing the Modern World

#### The Path to Universal Molecular Manufacturing:
* Domesticate mycelium as a crop
* Prove it with food and materials
* Scale through farms worldwide
* Direct increasingly complex structures
* Grow what we used to make
* Natural material abundance

"You never change things by fighting the existing reality. To change something, build a new model
that makes the existing model obsolete." — Buckminster Fuller
Now
[ CNN 2026 Watch Full Segment ][5]

### Mycelium Foundry

#### Building Material Abundance

We control mycelium growth at scale through strain development, environmental programming, and whole
system optimization.

#### Current Capacity:
* **2 farms:** Swersey Silos (Green Island, NY) and Pietro Mushroom Farm (Pennsylvania)
* **Ecovative HQ:** 180,000 sq ft lab, engineering, pilot, and commercial production
* **Annual throughput:** 10+ million lbs of feedstock converted to high-value mycelium products

#### Demonstrated Scale:
* Proven technology transfer to partner farms with consistent yields above target (7%+ at Swersey
  Silos, 6%+ at partner sites)
* Contract manufacturing model enables capital-light expansion through existing mushroom farm
  infrastructure
* Active discussions with additional farm partners in North America and Europe
* 2025 production: Record weekly outputs exceeding 2,700 cases, with year-end run rate above $4M ARR

#### Data Scale:
* **ML Model Maximizes Growth:** 26,000 records training AI models; 4,500 hours of growth analyzed
* **Environmental Monitoring:** 25 conditions tracked in real-time
* **Example Program:** 800 strains tested, 250 recipes, 200 substrate compositions, 40 supplements

### Why Now?

[ PBS 2024 Watch Full Episode ][3]

Eighteen years of R&D reached commercial maturity in 2024. We achieved direct margin positive
manufacturing—not in a pilot, but at commercial scale across multiple facilities.

The industry's first new mycelium crop in 400 years is now in production. It turns faster than any
plant-based alternative on shelf.

Consumer demand for clean-label whole foods is accelerating precisely as our economics crossed the
profitability threshold.

The AirMycelium™ platform integrates directly with existing mushroom farming infrastructure,
unlocking 450 million square meters of global capacity already built, already operating.

We scale quickly and capital light. Over five years we've proven technology transfer works: contract
growers reach target yields within months.

Twenty years of accumulated knowhow and forty patents protect our process. But the strongest moat is
operational excellence—cultivated across strain optimization, new technology development, and
feedstock-to-food transformation at multi-million pound scale.

Now

### We Grow [Food]

[Chef Nick cooking MyBacon]

#### Farmed. Not Fake.

That thesis is on shelf today.

We transform wildtype gourmet mycelium into whole, sliceable meat alternatives grown indoors.

Unlike extruded protein isolates formed into shapes, mycelium delivers natural whole-cut texture in
large, sliced strips—ready to cook like traditional meat.

Indoor cultivation keeps environmental impact low while enabling year-round production.

The result is a versatile protein, rich in fiber, that consumers actually buy twice.

**MyBacon** is whole slices of meaty mycelium, brined using our signature recipe, ready to heat and
serve.

#### Velocity:

MyBacon is the fastest-selling vegan bacon in the natural channel, with roughly 2× category velocity
per SPINS.

#### Distribution:

Now in 3,000+ stores nationwide, with distribution across all 50 states, including Whole Foods,
Giant, Hannaford, Natural Grocers, Schnucks, Gelson's.

#### Economics:

Unit costs dropped 65% year-over-year. We reached direct margin positive in 2025. We price against
premium products.

Scale, strain optimization, and operational discipline provide a multi-decade pipeline to maximally
competitive cost position globally.

#### The Path to Universal Molecular Manufacturing:
* Domesticate mycelium as a crop
* Prove it with food and materials
* Scale through farms worldwide
* Direct increasingly complex structures
* Grow what we used to make
* Natural material abundance

that makes the existing model obsolete." — Buckminster Fuller

We control mycelium growth at scale through strain development, environmental programming, and whole
system optimization.

* **Ecovative HQ:** 180,000 sq ft lab, engineering, pilot, and commercial production

* **Environmental Monitoring:** 25 conditions tracked in real-time
* **Example Program:** 800 strains tested, 250 recipes, 200 substrate compositions, 40 supplements

to the ingredients we put on our skin, to the medicines and foods we consume. Fossil fuels such as

## Capturing Carbon. Fueling the Future.

At LanzaTech, we’re turning waste carbon into new beginnings.

Using our proprietary bio-fermentation technology, we transform industrial emissions, carbon
dioxide, and gasified waste into **ethanol**—a building block for a wide range of sustainable
products, including **Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF)** and other critical chemical derivatives.

With **six commercial facilities** already in operation and more on the way, we’re scaling fast to
meet the world’s growing demand for fuels and materials. Our technology helps industrial sectors by
unlocking value from emissions that would otherwise go to waste.

Together with our partners, we’re building a **circular carbon economy**—where carbon is
continuously reused, not released.

[Learn more][26]

## CARBON CAPTURE & UTILIZATION

We partner with energy-intensive industries to capture and process carbon-rich gases before they
enter the atmosphere. We then give that carbon a second life by partnering with suppliers and brands
to integrate recycled carbon into their supply chains to make new products and materials.

What was once a vision is now delivering measurable results across heavy industry. Our technology is
enhancing energy security, building resilient operations worldwide, and—together with our
partners—reinforcing critical supply chains. 

## Leadership

## Dr. Jennifer Holmgren

## /

## CEO

Jennifer is the Chief Executive Officer of LanzaTech. Jennifer has over 20 years of experience in
the energy sector including a proven track record in the development and commercialization of fuels
and chemicals technologies.


## THE PROCESS

waste

## Creating Value

## Environmental Impact

Life cycle analysis (LCA) is essential for understanding the environmental benefits of LanzaTech’s
technology. LanzaTech has developed in-house LCA expertise and engages in collaborations to
understand and develop recommendations for methodological approaches which vary by region. We
regularly work with specialists around the world including: The European Commission (EC)/ Joint
Research Council (JRC), Roundtable for Sustainable Biomaterials (RSB), International Civil Aviation
Organization (ICAO), International Sustainability & Carbon Certification (ISCC), California Air
Resources Board (CARB), Argonne National Laboratory (ANL), Michigan Technological University (MTU),
Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and others.

LCAs consider the impacts of producing and using all energy and chemical inputs into the final
product(s). Third party analyses are used wherever possible and are available to our customers. We
also conduct LCAs for peer review, using in-house engineering data and emission factors from
appropriate published LCA-specific databases and third-party market projections.

[Here you can find an example][27] of a peer reviewed LCA for carbon negative chemicals production,
published in [Nature Biotechnology.][28]

[Here is an example][29] of a third party LCA for high purity ethanol which includes transportation
to Europe. As more facilities using our technology come online globally, the impact of
transportation on the LCA will be greatly reduced. LanzaTech continues to conduct LCAs on each
facility, exploring different methodologies and parameters. We are currently completing an internal
review of an LCA of the same facility for fuel grade ethanol to the factory gate. This will be
published after it has been reviewed by a third party. Current estimates of the resulting LCA show a
significant reduction relative to high purity ethanol being shipped to Europe.

## P2 is Powered by
## Green Chemistry

## P2 Science is a technology company transforming nature’s building blocks into powerful chemistry
## in a completely new way using the 12 Principles of Green Chemistry.
## 
## We are taking the harmful chemicals out of consumer goods and replacing them with safer,
## high-performance ingredients accessible to all. Reducing dependence on fossil-based raw materials

## What is Green Chemistry?

Green Chemistry is the foundation of everything P2 does - from developing new reactor technologies
and high-performance liquid polymers, to breaking down barriers for planet-safe products in
industries that affect everyday life.

By designing with the 12 Principles of Green Chemistry in mind, P2 is making sustainability
accessible, scalable, and efficient from start to finish.

[ Learn more ][40]

P2 is a recognized innovator for high performance natural polymers

Fast Company magazine recognized P2 as one of its Most Innovative Companies for a second consecutive
year, ranking #2 in the beauty category for Citropol^{®} F - the groundbreaking fragrance enhancer
that represents the next step in fragrance performance.

[ All Awards & Achievements ][41]

## We Are P2 Science

P2 Science was started by two scientists from Yale University, who were disheartened by the
widespread use of non-sustainable, synthetic compounds found in everyday use. P2 Science started
with a simple vision - develop high performance, innovative ingredients that align with planetary
health.

Holding to the 12 Principles of Green Chemistry, over the past 14 years, P2 Science has become a
global leader in bringing naturally derived, sustainable ingredients to market; partnering with
brands and manufacturers in 25 countries.

**Your learning and relationships should grow all year long — and now, they will!**

Starting in 2026, ACD Regional Meetings will follow a new seasonal schedule, with meetings held in
the Winter, Spring, and Fall, rotating to different cities each year to make participation more
accessible for members nationwide. Alongside these enhanced Regionals, we are also excited to share
the confirmed dates and locations for ChemEdge, the Washington Fly-In, and the 2026 Annual Meeting.

Whether you are building new connections, strengthening your team’s capabilities, or tackling
industry challenges together, ACD events bring our community closer, wherever you are.

**More details on each event will be available soon. We look forward to seeing you there.**

chemicals with strategic commercialization planning and complex product registration and compliance
matters.

We partner with our clients to help them get products quickly and efficiently to market — in any
country or locale — and keep them there when challenged by a new regulatory regime, issue, or set of
rules.

## Our Products

### [Pharmaceuticals][32]

Anmol Chemicals manufactures a range of pharmaceuticals, including active pharmaceutical ingredients
and excipients, in accordance with BP/EP/USP-NF/IP and international pharmaceutical standards.
Modern manufacturing facilities in Anmol are able to offer material that is specifically customized
to meet any technical or particle size requirements.

[ View More][33]

### [Vitamins][34]

Anmol Chemicals specialize in manufacturing high-quality vitamin ingredients that meet global
standards for purity, safety and performance. With decades of expertise in fine chemicals, we
deliver reliable, consistent vitamin grades used across pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, food, feed
and cosmetic industries.

[ View More][35]

### [Nutraceuticals][36]

Anmol Chemicals manufactures a wide range of nutraceuticals. The term “Nutraceutical” combines the
two words of “Nutrient,” which is a nourishing food component, and “Pharmaceutical,” which is a
medical drug.

[View More][37]

### [Speciality Chemicals][38]

Anmol Chemicals manufactures a wide spectrum of speciality chemicals and is known for its culture of
innovation, which frequently updates and introduces high-performing functional compounds. This
product line is customer-focused and application-specific, and it is employed in a variety of end
use areas.

[View More][39]

### [Mineral Fortifiers][40]

Anmol Chemicals products feature controlled microbiological quality, active mineral fortifiers, and
additives that are widely used to fortify foods, sports drinks, beverages, cereals, dairy products,
and meal replacements. They are fully GMO-free and produced in accordance with FCC requirements.

[View More][41]

### [Pharmaceuticals][42]

Anmol Chemicals Pharmaceuticals encompassing active pharmaceutical ingredients & excipients as per
BP/EP/USP-NF/IP Pharmacopeia standards. Anmol Chemicals state of art manufacturing facilities are
flexible to deliver customized material in terms of any dedicated technical.

# Speeding up your biobased innovation

## A unique, flexible, multi-purpose state-of-the-art pilot facility for the bioeconomy

#### Process development, scale-up and custom manufacturing of innovative biobased products and
#### processes.

Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant is an independent, state-of-the-art facility that operates from
a laboratory level to a multi-ton scale. Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant is a service provider
for process development, scale-up and custom manufacturing of biobased products and processes. A
wide and flexible spectrum of modular unit operations combined with the experience of our highly
competent engineers and technicians enables us to translate your biobased lab protocol into a viable
industrial process.

Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant enables the conversion of renewable feedstocks into biochemicals,
biomaterials, biofuels and other bioproducts by using technologies such as biomass pretreatment,
biocatalysis, precision fermentation (up to 75,000 L), biomass fermentation (up to 75,000 L), gas
fermentation, green chemistry and product recovery and purification (downstream processing).

## Welcome to Bio Green Energy Solutions

  Environmental     Ocean-Recycling     Animal-Protection     Renewable-Energy  

## We Are Pioneers In The World Of Solar & Renewable Energy!

We are a dedicated biogas and renewable energy consulting firm committed to helping industries,
farmers, and entrepreneurs build a sustainable future. Our expertise lies in **biogas plant
consultancy**, **CBG project planning**, and **waste-to-energy solutions** tailored for India’s
unique needs

Whether you are looking to set up a small-scale biogas unit or a commercial compressed biogas (CBG)
plant, we provide **end-to-end support** — from feasibility to implementation.

We assist with approvals, subsidies, and technical support to streamline your project. Our goal is
to ensure smooth execution and lasting impact.

[ Learn More ][58]

## Our Services

We enable the shift to sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy through expert consulting and
innovation.

INTEGRATED BIO-CHEMICAL MANUFACTURING

# Where biology meets
# chemistry.
# *At scale.*

One integrated platform for the industrialized production of bio-based chemicals - engineered for
performance, cost efficiency, and sovereignty. 

[ Explore the platform ][11]

THE PROBLEM

### The way we manufacture chemicals needs *an upgrade* 

Today, biology and chemistry are built in silos *–* two powerful disciplines disconnected 

**Chemical manufacturing is fragile
and unsustainable** 

Scalable – but built on petroleum and concentrated oleochemical supply chains, it faces
sustainability pressure and geopolitical risk. 

**Biomanufacturing has a narrow
product scope ** 

Local, renewable feedstocks and sustainable production - but comes with a limited product range and
long development timelines 

OUR FOUNDATION

### We leverage the best of both disciplines,
### *built as one.*  

Biology delivers sustainable platform molecules locally, chemistry multiplies the product scope and
scales output. A single, integrated continuous manufacturing process from renewable feedstocks to
finished product.  

**Resilient
**local, diversified feedstocks 

**Sustainable
**biological production from renewable sources  

**Scalable & versatile
**chemical diversification without reinventing biology each time

## Next-generation bio-based chemical manufacturing *starts here.*

[ Get in touch ][12]

OUR APPROACH

### One process.
### Biology and chemistry, *engineered together.*

BioTreasure integrates circular continuous precision fermentation with proprietary chemistry into
one modular manufacturing system.

**01**

**Renewable Feedstocks**

Domestic, flexible sourcing from renewable carbon inputs

**02**

**Circular Continuous Fermentation**

Precision fermentation for circular continuous industrial operation

**03**

**Integrated Proprietary Chemistry**

Chemical routes co-designed with upstream biology

**Bio-Based Chemicals **

Multiple industries – one modular platform

  domestic supply.
* [Personal & Home Care Upcycled, bio-based specialty ingredients that reduce dependence on volatile
  tropical oil and petrochemical supply chains.]

* [Agrochemicals]

[ Get in touch ][13]

THE ADVANTAGE

### The bio-based chemical manufacturing platform
### *built to scale.*

We engineer biology and chemistry as a single, integrated platform, so every new molecule builds on

# Raw Materials Supplier USA

Bisley International deploys a holistic understanding of markets, technical insight and logistics
excellence to build durable strategies which unite the world’s best raw material producers with
industrial consumers in North America. We supply and distribute a wide range of specialty chemicals,
minerals, raw materials and more...

[About Us][55] [View Products][56]

WHAT WE DO

## Industry experts & the trusted chemical raw material supplier in the USA & Worldwide

Established in Houston, Texas, USA, Bisley International draws on the global reach of the
multinational Bisley Group, with 65 years of experience in marketing and as distributor of chemical
products and high quality industrial raw materials throughout Asia Pacific, Oceania and the Middle
East.

[Contact Sales][57] [Visit Bisley Group Australia][58]

As international raw materials and chemical suppliers, our products range from Fine Industrial
Chemicals for highly specialised applications, to bulk raw materials delivered in shiploads to major
regional manufacturers.

Our goal is to provide a complete package of technically outstanding products, supported by
proficient, responsive staff and first class logistics to a range of industries.

**Our Value Proposition**
We pride ourselves in our ability to add value and create synergies for our supplier and customer
partners.

**Our Guarantees**
We believe it’s important to focus on what is most valuable to our customers and really stand by
this - for the long term.

**Our strategic network…**
Our experienced team of logistics experts are able to track our cargo movements from factories
across the globe right to our customer’s doorstep, whilst keeping all stakeholders informed with up
to date information.

Bisley International is supported by the Bisley Group, with headquarters in Sydney, Australia.
Global chemical sourcing is also supported through our network of offices in the UAE, Bangkok,
Singapore, Malaysia, New Zealand, Indonesia and USA.

## The CHT Group

Since the foundation of CHT Germany GmbH in Tübingen more than 70 years ago, the CHT Group has
developed into a globally active group of companies with a focus on specialty chemicals as function
providers, auxiliaries and additives for industrial processes.
 

[Learn more][65]

#### Sustainability

## Responsible, consistent, transparent

As a foundation-owned company, CHT is always aware of its social responsibility and its
responsibility towards the environment. Through a sustainable corporate strategy, the Group not only
ensures its long-term success, but also makes a positive contribution along the entire value chain.
This is realized on the basis of uniform global principles, ambitious targets and maximum
transparency.

# Color Meanings – Discover the Power and Symbolism Behind Every Hue

[Color Meanings]

Colors play an exceptionally prominent role in our lives. They influence our thinking, inspire our
decision-making, and impact our moods. From causing changes to changing reactions, colors are more
powerful than we think. Depending on our interpretations, they can be used for both good and evil.
Fortunately, we have the power to welcome some colors and shun others. This guide will take you on a
journey through the exciting universe of color meanings.

It’s important to note that not all colors were created equal. Though some shades are similar, that
doesn’t mean they’ll awaken the same emotions. To truly grasp the meaning of color, we must learn to
accept this. It’s also imperative to relinquish some control. Try as we might, we won’t always have
a handle on our emotions. Colors have such a substantial effect on the mind and body, and until we
make our peace with this reality, we’ll remain forever perplexed by inexplicable and random
reactions.

**You can read about each color meaning by clicking the links below:**
1.  [Red][26]
2.  [Orange][27]
3.  [Yellow][28]
4.  [Green][29]
5.  [Turquoise][30]
6.  [Blue][31]
7.  [Purple][32]
8.  [Pink][33]
9.  [Brown][34]
10. [Black][35]
11. [Gray][36]
12. [White][37]

## Recognizing Your Responses

Have you ever noticed a shift in your attitude while surrounded by a particular color? Perhaps
you’ve been overwhelmed with nostalgia while staring at a specific shade. You’ve likely written
these occurrences off as a common human response, but the cause is far more complex than that. Color
psychology teaches us that much of human behavior is dictated by color. When we open our minds to
this possibility, we begin to understand the scope of our perceptions.

## Personal Cognizance

Once we acknowledge that colors influence doings, it makes way for personal interpretations. In
other words, we level the playing field by regaining some control of how we react to colors. You may
realize that the color red triggers anger. To avoid unnecessary bouts of rage, limit your encounters
with this hue. On the other hand, yellow might make you feel cheery and upbeat. If so, introduce
more of this color into your life. With a healthy dose of awareness, you can somewhat manage the
moods and emotions that colors produce.

## Uncovering New Meanings

The psychology behind color is fascinating and ever-expanding. With that said, new meanings are
always coming to light. The more knowledge we acquire, the more informed we become. This prospect
promises great hope for future research.

What’s more, our minds are in a perpetual state of evolvement. In essence, though some colors have
fixed explanations, these findings can always shift. This fact is both unsettling and reassuring. As
researchers continue to delve into the many facets of the color wheel, new information is
continually revealing itself.

## Diversify Your Understandings

While reading these articles, you’ll develop a deeper understanding of what colors mean, how they
make an impression on us, and the ways we perceive them. The notion that colors are so dynamic may
seem absurd to some, but there’s no refuting this truth. This concept often eludes us because we
don’t realize how frequently colors control us. Certain hues can evoke fond memories. Others may
give rise to dreadful feelings.

## An Overview of Color Meanings

To help you discover the celebrated phenomenon of colors, here’s an overview of each color’s
meaning, what it symbolizes, and how it affects human emotion and behavior.

### 1. Red Color Meaning

[[Red Color Meaning Infographic][Red Color Meaning Infographic]][38]

The color of passion and energy. Red draws attention like no other color and radiates a strong and
powerful energy that motivates us to take action. It is also linked to sexuality and stimulates deep
and intimate passion. Red is ubiquitously used to warn and signal caution and danger.

[Read more about the color red][39]

### 2. Orange Color Meaning

[[Orange Color Meaning Infographic][Orange Color Meaning Infographic]][40]

The color of enthusiasm and emotion. Orange exudes warmth and joy and is considered a fun color that
provides emotional strength. It is optimistic and upliftning, adds spontaneity and positivity to
life and it encourages social communication and creativity. It is a youthful and energetic color.

[Read more about the color orange][41]
