## Recognizing Your Responses

Have you ever noticed a shift in your attitude while surrounded by a particular color? Perhaps
you’ve been overwhelmed with nostalgia while staring at a specific shade. You’ve likely written
these occurrences off as a common human response, but the cause is far more complex than that. Color
psychology teaches us that much of human behavior is dictated by color. When we open our minds to
this possibility, we begin to understand the scope of our perceptions.

## Personal Cognizance

Once we acknowledge that colors influence doings, it makes way for personal interpretations. In
other words, we level the playing field by regaining some control of how we react to colors. You may
realize that the color red triggers anger. To avoid unnecessary bouts of rage, limit your encounters
with this hue. On the other hand, yellow might make you feel cheery and upbeat. If so, introduce
more of this color into your life. With a healthy dose of awareness, you can somewhat manage the
moods and emotions that colors produce.

## Uncovering New Meanings

The psychology behind color is fascinating and ever-expanding. With that said, new meanings are
always coming to light. The more knowledge we acquire, the more informed we become. This prospect
promises great hope for future research.

What’s more, our minds are in a perpetual state of evolvement. In essence, though some colors have
fixed explanations, these findings can always shift. This fact is both unsettling and reassuring. As
researchers continue to delve into the many facets of the color wheel, new information is
continually revealing itself.

## Diversify Your Understandings

While reading these articles, you’ll develop a deeper understanding of what colors mean, how they
make an impression on us, and the ways we perceive them. The notion that colors are so dynamic may
seem absurd to some, but there’s no refuting this truth. This concept often eludes us because we
don’t realize how frequently colors control us. Certain hues can evoke fond memories. Others may
give rise to dreadful feelings.

## An Overview of Color Meanings

meaning, what it symbolizes, and how it affects human emotion and behavior.

The color of passion and energy. Red draws attention like no other color and radiates a strong and
powerful energy that motivates us to take action. It is also linked to sexuality and stimulates deep
and intimate passion. Red is ubiquitously used to warn and signal caution and danger.

[Read more about the color red][39]

### 2. Orange Color Meaning

[[Orange Color Meaning Infographic][Orange Color Meaning Infographic]][40]

The color of enthusiasm and emotion. Orange exudes warmth and joy and is considered a fun color that
provides emotional strength. It is optimistic and upliftning, adds spontaneity and positivity to
life and it encourages social communication and creativity. It is a youthful and energetic color.

[Read more about the color orange][41]

### 3. Yellow Color Meaning

[[Yellow Color Meaning Infographic][Yellow Color Meaning Infographic]][42]

The color of happiness and optimism. Yellow is a cheerful and energetic color that brings fun and
joy to the world. It makes learning easier as it affects the logical part of the brain, stimulating
mentality and perception. It inspires thought and curiosity and boosts enthusiasm and confidence.

[Read more about the color yellow][43]

### 4. Green Color Meaning

[[Green Color Meaning Infographic][Green Color Meaning Infographic]][44]

The color of harmony and health. Green is a generous, relaxing color that revitalizes our body and
mind. It balances our emotions and leaves us feeling safe and secure. It also gives us hope, with
promises of growth and prosperity, and it provides a little bit of luck to help us along the way.

[Read more about the color green][45]

### 5. Turquoise Color Meaning

[[Turquoise Color Meaning Infographic][Turquoise Color Meaning Infographic]][46]

The color of calmness and clarity. Turquoise stabilizes emotions and increases empathy and
compassion. It emits a cool calming peace, gives us a boost of positive mental energy that improves
concentration and clarifies our mind, and creates a balance that clears the path to spiritual
growth.

[Read more about the color turquoise][47]

### 6. Blue Color Meaning

[[Blue Color Meaning Infographic][Blue Color Meaning Infographic]][48]

The color of trust and loyalty. Blue has a calming and relaxing effect on our psyche, that gives us
peace and makes us feel confident and secure. It dislikes confrontation and too much attention, but
it is an honest, reliable and responsible color and you can always count on its support.

[Read more about the color blue][49]

## company overview

Founded in 1980, Esters and Solvents has been a trusted name in specialty chemicals and ingredients,
built on values of innovation, quality, and customer focus.

We manufacture high-performance chemicals and ingredients for personal care & cosmetics, fragrances
& flavours, leather, textiles and coatings—blending technical expertise with consistent quality.

Backed by over four decades of industry experience and a strong commitment to sustainability, we
deliver reliable, high-performance solutions—customized to meet specific client needs and trusted by
partners across diverse global markets.

# the experts in complex specialty chemical synthesis

FutureFuel is a leader in custom chemical manufacturing of specialty chemicals. With 50 years of
manufacturing experience, we are a flexible and dependable partner to deliver your company's
finished product safely and reliably. FutureFuel’s commitment extends beyond production,
encompassing a collaborative approach to ensure our customer’s vision is realized with precision and
efficiency.

FutureFuel offers partners the opportunity to co-locate manufacturing operations within its fully
equipped, 2,200-acre complex in Batesville, Arkansas. By leveraging existing permits, integrated
utilities, logistics, waste management systems, and a highly skilled workforce, partners can focus
on core process technology rather than site development. This collaborative model is ideally suited
for companies launching new products, expanding or reshoring production, or scaling innovative
technologies in a low-risk, asset-rich setting.

##### [Process Development][33]

Require a specific solution? We excel in developing processes to meet the individual needs of our
customers. A proven stage-gate process allows us to efficiently and effectively evaluate, develop,
and implement projects, small and large, in a timely manner.

##### [Process Hazard Evaluation & Scaleup][34]

Safety is a top priority at FutureFuel. We complete a thorough assessment of all hazardous chemicals
before beginning any process development. We efficiently scale processes from 1L to 2000-3000 GL to
offer seamless transitions from lab-scale to full production.

##### [Custom Manufacturing][35]

We can work with technical packages provided by our customers or we can develop new customized
processes to meet your specific needs. Let us help you design, engineer, and scale-up your processes
in quantities ranging from thousands to many millions of lbs per year.

##### [Analytical Services
##### and Quality Control][36]

We offer a full range of services to support process development, optimization, and quality control
of products. Nearly all testing is performed in our fully equipped, on-site laboratories to allow
faster times to commercialization while maintaining the highest quality that our customers expect.

##### [Environmental and
##### Sustainability Management][37]

FutureFuel upholds stringent environmental standards, placing a strong emphasis on waste management
and conservation of energy and water to reduce our carbon footprint. We actively demonstrate our
commitment by working with our customers to design and develop products that can be manufactured,
transported, and used in a safe manner.

##### [Customer
##### Interface][38]

At every step of the process, FutureFuel actively engages with its customers to ensure a
collaborative and transparent process. We work to address each customer’s unique requirements and
offer tailored solutions to meet their needs.

[ learn more ][39]

products to meet emerging and unmet needs in the markets we serve including Detergents, Coatings,
Adhesives, Polymers, and Personal Care.

# Bio-Solutions For a

# Bio-Solutions For a
# Greener Tomorrow

### ***GEMTEK** Products* formulates and manufactures industrial cleaners, degreasers, solvents and
### specialty chemicals derived from renewable, biobased resources.

As a pioneer in the biobased industry, **GEMTEK** Products remains steadfast in its commitment to
the research, development, and manufacturing of non-toxic, environmentally safe cleaners,
degreasers, solvents, and specialty chemicals. Since 1992, **GEMTEK** has played a key role in the
global transition away from petroleum- and synthetic-based chemistries toward sustainable,
plant-based alternatives. By combining advanced green chemistry with performance standards, the
company has consistently delivered products that meet the demand of industrial, commercial, and
institutional users without compromising environmental integrity or worker safety.

Over the past three decades, **GEMTEK** has built a reputation for innovation, reliability, and
regulatory leadership, helping organizations reduce hazardous waste, lower VOC emissions, and
support safer workplace practices. Through a strong focus on sustainability, compliance, and
customer-driven innovation, **GEMTEK** continues to shape the future of worldwide environmental
responsibility.

### In keeping with the company’s mission statement…

### “Safely Cleaning Planet Earth”, **GEMTEK** is committed to providing its customers with a value
### – high quality products at a competitive price.

**GEMTEK** believes that superior cleaning and industrial performance should never come at the
expense of human health, workplace safety, or environmental sustainability. For this reason,
**GEMTEK** maintains a strict commitment to formulating products without the use of toxic,
hazardous, or environmentally damaging chemistries commonly found in traditional petroleum- and
synthetic-based solutions.  This commitment enables customers to achieve operational efficiency and
dependable performance without compromising their sustainability goals.

The company’s mission extends beyond product manufacturing; it reflects a broader dedication to
responsible stewardship, continuous innovation, and long-term environmental accountability. By
prioritizing safety, performance, and environmental responsibility in every aspect of its business,
**GEMTEK** continues to uphold its vision of “Safely Cleaning Planet Earth” for current and future
generations.

# Together we can do even better chemistry.

## Green Chemical Design - How to meet an urgent industry need

### Purpose

To be a leader in the response to the demand for a fully sustainable chemicals industry, by helping
to introduce new solutions to serious needs for substitution of hazardous substances, and
development of new green chemistry

### Business Model

To participate in and facilitate multidisciplinary teams involving all stakeholders in the
development of new products. This includes business leaders and scientists. We have the team players
needed to deliver new strategies for `safe and sustainable by design` chemistry.

### Principles

Our innovations fully-recognise green chemistry principles, and our work is not driven by profit but
by the need for change towards a sustainable industry. The challenges require broad knowledge of all
aspects of the industry and the use of the necessary skills, from computational chemistry, hazard,
risk, engineering, and more.

### Impact

To help facilitate the reduction in the use of hazardous substances by the optimal use of those
substances that are already well-understood and by innovation. The long-term viability of the
chemical industry depends on its regeneration in a cost-effective way.

## Value Proposition

We provide value in our technical strengths and understanding the strategy for development of new
commercially-viable approaches.

see the [Business Context][14]

**New chemicals come from**
* **novel ideas** on how to substitute and avoid use of toxic substances
* techniques for the **simultaneous** consideration of the desired performance of a product and its
  hazard or risk
* the use of highly **biodegradable** substances

# Together we can do even better chemistry.

## Green Chemical Design - How to meet an urgent industry need

### Purpose

To be a leader in the response to the demand for a fully sustainable chemicals industry, by helping
to introduce new solutions to serious needs for substitution of hazardous substances, and
development of new green chemistry

### Business Model

To participate in and facilitate multidisciplinary teams involving all stakeholders in the
development of new products. This includes business leaders and scientists. We have the team players
needed to deliver new strategies for `safe and sustainable by design` chemistry.

### Principles

Our innovations fully-recognise green chemistry principles, and our work is not driven by profit but
by the need for change towards a sustainable industry. The challenges require broad knowledge of all
aspects of the industry and the use of the necessary skills, from computational chemistry, hazard,
risk, engineering, and more.

### Impact

To help facilitate the reduction in the use of hazardous substances by the optimal use of those
substances that are already well-understood and by innovation. The long-term viability of the
chemical industry depends on its regeneration in a cost-effective way.

## Value Proposition

We provide value in our technical strengths and understanding the strategy for development of new
commercially-viable approaches.

see the [Business Context][14]

* **novel ideas** on how to substitute and avoid use of toxic substances
* techniques for the **simultaneous** consideration of the desired performance of a product and its

* the use of highly **biodegradable** substances
* essential **R&D** and **regulatory experience**
* use of **risk characterisation** as part of the comparison of alternatives

What We Do

## We make fuel from waste.
## Not as a compromise — as an upgrade.

Greenjoules is a deep-tech biorefinery operating from Chakan, Pune. We take agri-waste and
agro-industrial residues — materials that would otherwise be burned in open fields — and convert
them through a proprietary thermochemical process into second-generation biofuels that are
chemically indistinguishable from their fossil counterparts.

The critical difference: our fuels carry among the lowest lifecycle carbon footprints of any fuel
available anywhere in the world today. And unlike first-generation biofuels, not a single food crop
is diverted.

🌾

#### Zero food vs. fuel conflict

Agricultural residues only — rice husk, sugarcane press mud, paddy straw. No cropland diverted. No
food chain disrupted.

🔬

#### Proprietary process technology

Our thermochemical conversion process is developed and owned entirely by our team. No licensed IP,
no royalty dependency — full technical control at every step.

⛽

#### True drop-in replacement

Meets BIS:1460 (Indian diesel standard). Surpasses Euro VI. No engine or infrastructure modification
required — it simply replaces fossil diesel, litre for litre.

## What is a HTML color code?

A HTML color code is an identifier used to represent a color on the web and within other digital
assets. Common color codes are in the forms of: a keyword name, a hexadecimal value, a RGB (red,
green, blue) triplet, or a HSL (hue, saturation, lightness) triplet. Different values allow for
16,777,216 potential colors to be chosen.

For example, the color red can be identifier using the following formats:
* red (keyword name)
* #ff0000 (hex)
* (255,0,0) (RGB)
* (0, 100%, 50%) (HSL)

Because there are so many colors to choose from, tools have been created to make the task of
selection much simpler. A color picker allows a user to select a color by clicking on visual range
of color to pin-point an exact code. A color chart provides a listing of common colors for quick
selection.

To use a selected color code within your web page, you could place the following attribute within a
given element to change its background color to red: `style="background-color: #ff0000;"`

## What are HTML color codes used for?

HTML color codes are used within HTML and CSS to create web design color schemes. They are primarily
used by web designers, graphic designers, computer programmers, and digital illustrators. Choosing
the correct web colors can be exhausting, but it is a great skill to have, especially for marketing
purposes.

To read more about html colors, Wikipedia has a good resource on web colors:
[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_colors][27].

## What are basic HTML color codes?

black, #000000, rgb(0,0,0) white, #FFFFFF, rgb(255,255,255) silver, #C0C0C0, rgb(192,192,192 grey,
#808080, rgb(128,128,128) maroon, #800000, rgb(128,0,0) red, #FF0000, rgb(255,0,0) purple, #800080,
rgb(128,0,128) fuchsia, #FF00FF, rgb(255,0,255) green, #008000, rgb(0,128,0) lime, #00FF00,
rgb(0,255,0) olive, #808000, rgb(128,128,0) yellow, #FFFF00, rgb(255,255,0) navy, #000080,
rgb(0,0,128) blue, #0000FF, rgb(0,0,255) teal, #008080, rgb(0,128,128) aqua, #00FFFF, rgb(0,255,255)

## From every atom of our products to every heartbeat of our workforce, we stand for being green in
## our thoughts, values and actions.

We are India’s leading green chemical company. We offer the finest performance chemicals such as
Glycols, Glycol Ethers, Acetates, Bio-Polymers, Natural Gums, and Potable Alcohol that have end
applications across businesses and industries. Inspired by nature and chemistry, we create compounds
based on decades of expertise, innovative engineering and sustainable technologies that touch
millions of lives every day while ensuring our environment remains untouched.

make the world a greener and cleaner place at an accelerated pace

solutions. Each product in our portfolio has been designed to help you face the sustainability

## Innovating with Purpose: Sustainable Chemical Solutions for Modern Industries

We provide a plethora of chemical solutions for contemporary industries. Our commitment to being
eco-friendly does not hinder our provision of high-performance Adhesives modern Inks and
environmentally acceptable Coatings that simplify and enhance performance.

At the forefront of chemical manufacturing, we provide a diverse portfolio of high-performance
chemicals tailored for today’s dynamic industrial needs. From advanced adhesives and cutting-edge
inks to eco-friendly coatings, our solutions are designed to deliver exceptional results while
supporting global sustainability goals.

As a trusted sustainable chemical manufacturer, we are deeply committed to reducing environmental
impact without compromising on quality or efficiency. Our sustainable chemical production processes
incorporate cleaner technologies, responsible sourcing, and rigorous quality control to ensure our
products meet the highest industry standards.
We believe that innovation and sustainability can and must go hand in hand. Whether you’re seeking
performance-driven solutions for packaging, construction, printing, or specialty applications, our
chemical technologies simplify workflows, improve productivity, and help our partners build a
greener future.

## FAQS

[ What industries does Innokan serve with its sustainable chemical solutions?
][21]

Innokan caters to a diverse range of industries, including packaging, printing, construction,
plastics, rubber, and advanced materials. Our eco-friendly adhesives, inks, and coatings are
designed to meet the specific needs of each sector while promoting sustainability.

[ How does Innokan ensure the sustainability of its chemical products?
][22]

We prioritize sustainability by integrating green chemistry principles into our product development.
Our manufacturing processes utilize cleaner technologies, responsible sourcing, and rigorous quality
control to minimize environmental impact without compromising on performance.

[ Where is Innokan's manufacturing facility located?
][23]

Our state-of-the-art facility is situated in Kundli, Sonipat, Haryana, strategically positioned to
serve clients across India and beyond.

[ What types of inks does Innokan offer for printing applications?
][24]

We provide a variety of inks tailored for different substrates and applications, including:

Water-Based Inks: Ideal for paper and cardboard, offering reduced VOC emissions.

Solvent-Based Inks: Suitable for non-porous surfaces like plastic and metal, ensuring excellent
adhesion.

UV-Curable Inks: Designed for high-speed printing with minimal environmental impact.
Each type is engineered to deliver vibrant prints with superior adhesion and clarity.

[ How can I contact Innokan for inquiries or orders?
][25]

You can reach us via email at info@innokan.com or visit our website at innokan.com for more
information. Our team is ready to assist you with your chemical solution needs.

About Us

## Jotis Green Chemicals

Founded in 2006, Jotis Green Chemicals Pvt. Ltd is a leading manufacturer of specialty rubber
chemicals for latex-based goods. Our commitment to green chemistry drives innovation that minimizes
environmental impact while maximizing performance and value.

We developed an advanced zero-effluent manufacturing process, ensuring sustainability throughout
production and end use. At Jotis, we focus on Environment, Safety, and Health (ESH) standards,
leveraging every opportunity to optimize the planet’s precious resources.

Z

#### Innovation in Green Chemistry

At Jotis Green Chemicals Pvt. Ltd, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our R&D team
continuously develops high-performance latex chemicals designed to enhance process efficiency and
product quality while reducing energy consumption and waste.

Z

#### Sustainability and Global Standards

We operate under globally recognized Environment, Safety, and Health (ESH) protocols. From
zero-effluent processes to resource-efficient operations, our sustainability framework ensures
responsible production and long-term environmental protection.

[Know More][21]

## Driving Innovation Through Green Chemistry

Jotis Green Chemicals Pvt. Ltd pioneers sustainable solutions for latex-based manufacturing,
combining eco-friendly innovation with unmatched performance and customer-focused service.



#### Green Manufacturing Excellence

Achieving zero effluent discharge through environmentally responsible production methods.



#### Advanced R&D Capabilities

Innovating specialty rubber chemicals that enhance product quality and reduce costs.

## Sustainable Solutions for the Latex Industry

engineered to enhance product quality, reduce waste, and protect the environment.

Our Products

## Explore Products

[View All Products][23]

#### SILGRIND

Silgrind is a specialized anionic dispersing agent for china clay. It is also a silane activator
which helps to develop stronger bonds between latex and china clay. 

[Read More][24]

#### TAMOX

Tamox is a proprietary preparation of alkyl phenolic antioxidants. It is non-staining,
non-discolouring, and specially suitable for products made from NR latex. 

[Read More][25]

#### Tamstab

Tamstab is an excellent stabilizer and MST builder for natural rubber latex. It does not form any
metallic complexes when used in compounds and is very stable in acidic and basic conditions.

[Read More][26]

#### SP Emulsion

Styrenated phenol emulsion is an antioxidant renowned for its non-staining, non-discolouring
properties. Our water-based emulsion leaves no residual oil.

[Read More][27]

#### FOMEX

Fomex is an excellent foam stabilizer for natural latex foam. It also acts as a secondary gelling
agent in place of DPG in the Dunlop process.

[Read More][28]

#### Welldip

Welldip is a fatty acid ester of selected non-edible vegetable oils suitably modified to perform as
a surface active agent in dipping formulations of natural rubber latex.

[Read More][29]

#### AQUA E-lm

Aqua E – LM is an emulsion of paraffinic light mineral oil which is used as a plasticizer for all
types of rubber latices. 

[Read More][30]

Our Products

## Explore Products

#### SILGRIND

Silgrind is a specialized anionic dispersing agent for china clay. It is also a silane activator
which helps to develop stronger bonds between latex and china clay. 

[Read More][24]

#### TAMOX

Tamox is a proprietary preparation of alkyl phenolic antioxidants. It is non-staining,
non-discolouring, and specially suitable for products made from NR latex. 

[Read More][25]

#### Tamstab

Tamstab is an excellent stabilizer and MST builder for natural rubber latex. It does not form any
metallic complexes when used in compounds and is very stable in acidic and basic conditions.

[Read More][26]

#### SP Emulsion

Styrenated phenol emulsion is an antioxidant renowned for its non-staining, non-discolouring
properties. Our water-based emulsion leaves no residual oil.

[Read More][27]

#### FOMEX

Fomex is an excellent foam stabilizer for natural latex foam. It also acts as a secondary gelling
agent in place of DPG in the Dunlop process.

[Read More][28]

#### Welldip

Welldip is a fatty acid ester of selected non-edible vegetable oils suitably modified to perform as
a surface active agent in dipping formulations of natural rubber latex.

[Read More][29]

#### AQUA E-lm

Aqua E – LM is an emulsion of paraffinic light mineral oil which is used as a plasticizer for all
types of rubber latices.

# Schützen Sie Ihre IT-Infrastruktur vor Hackern und Schadcode

## Mit dem meistgenutzten Open Source Vulnerability Management der Welt

Jeder Cyberangriff braucht eine passende Schwachstelle, um erfolgreich zu sein. Unsere Mission ist
es, Sicherheitslücken und Schwachstellen in der IT aufzudecken, bevor sie ausgenutzt werden können.
Wir reduzieren das Risiko und die Auswirkungen von Cyberangriffen auf Unternehmen, Organisationen
und Arbeitsplätze um bis zu 99,9 %.

Unsere [Schwachstellenmanagement-Lösungen][98] nutzen eine stetig wachsende Zahl an
Schwachstellentests, die wir täglich um neue Einträge erweitern. Die Erfolgsrate aufgedeckter
Schwachstellen (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures, CVE) liegt damit deutlich höher als bei den
Lösungen unserer Marktbegleiter.

Unser Schwachstellenmanagement ist in drei Produktlinien erhältlich: als dedizierte
[Hardware-Appliance][99], als [virtuelle Maschine (VM)][100], kompatibel mit allen gängigen
Hypervisoren, sowie als unsere Einstiegslösung [OPENVAS BASIC][101]. Mit über 100.000 Installationen
und mehr als 100 Partnerunternehmen kommt unser Schwachstellenmanagement rund um den Globus zum
Einsatz. Testen Sie uns!
* 99 % weniger Angriffsfläche durch Vulnerability Management
* Mehr als 15 Jahre Produkterfahrung und Marktakzeptanz
* Über 100.000 Installationen weltweit
* Mehr als 150 Länder, in denen unsere Lösungen zum Einsatz kommen
* 9 von 10 Kunden behalten unsere Lösung nach der Testphase

# Schützen Sie Ihre IT-Infrastruktur vor Hackern und Schadcode

## Mit dem meistgenutzten Open Source Vulnerability Management der Welt

Jeder Cyberangriff braucht eine passende Schwachstelle, um erfolgreich zu sein. Unsere Mission ist
es, Sicherheitslücken und Schwachstellen in der IT aufzudecken, bevor sie ausgenutzt werden können.
Wir reduzieren das Risiko und die Auswirkungen von Cyberangriffen auf Unternehmen, Organisationen
und Arbeitsplätze um bis zu 99,9 %.

Unsere [Schwachstellenmanagement-Lösungen][98] nutzen eine stetig wachsende Zahl an
Schwachstellentests, die wir täglich um neue Einträge erweitern. Die Erfolgsrate aufgedeckter
Schwachstellen (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures, CVE) liegt damit deutlich höher als bei den
Lösungen unserer Marktbegleiter.

Unser Schwachstellenmanagement ist in drei Produktlinien erhältlich: als dedizierte
[Hardware-Appliance][99], als [virtuelle Maschine (VM)][100], kompatibel mit allen gängigen
Hypervisoren, sowie als unsere Einstiegslösung [OPENVAS BASIC][101]. Mit über 100.000 Installationen
und mehr als 100 Partnerunternehmen kommt unser Schwachstellenmanagement rund um den Globus zum
Einsatz. Testen Sie uns!
* 99 % weniger Angriffsfläche durch Vulnerability Management
* Mehr als 15 Jahre Produkterfahrung und Marktakzeptanz
* Über 100.000 Installationen weltweit
* Mehr als 150 Länder, in denen unsere Lösungen zum Einsatz kommen
* 9 von 10 Kunden behalten unsere Lösung nach der Testphase
* Mehr als 100 Sales-Partner weltweit
* Über 15 Jahre Partnerschaft mit dem BSI

environments as per regulatory guidelines.

# P&G Chemicals develops bio-based materials that can be used in a wide range of applications.
* Our products are created from responsibly sourced natural feedstocks. [Learn more here][9].
* Our portfolio of fatty alcohols, fatty acids, methyl esters and glycerin offers you a choice of
  low carbon options, including carbon negative and near carbon neutral versions. [Learn more
  here][10].
* Suitable for use in a wide range of applications including: agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals,
  personal care, fabric & home care products and lubricants.

## New carbon footprint solutions

**P&G Chemicals offer a range of carbon footprint solutions to help meet your business needs and
those of your customers.**

Through a combination of sourcing and manufacturing expertise we are able to provide a range of
options.
Our Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) are calculated from cradle to gate and include biogenic uptake.

Regular

Our mainline offering provides a **lower carbon** footprint than industry average carbon footprint*.

[Learn More][11]

Low

Our premium offering has a **significantly lower carbon** footprint than industry average*, helping
you make progress on your decarbonization journey.

[Learn More][12]

Ultra Low

Our flagship offering is **carbon negative**, an ideal choice to help you develop carbon neutral
formulations.

[Learn More][13]

* based on ERASM 2017 SLE Project PKO data + PGC scope 1, 2 and 3. To learn more, please contact us
[here][14].

The methodology used to calculate the Carbon Footprint through our supply chain is based on the ISO
14067 standard and follows the **Together for Sustainability** guideline. It has been certified in
2024 by **TUV Rheinland**, an independent organization of experts. The Product Carbon Footprints
(PCF) offered under our 3 different solutions have been verified in 2024 by TÜV Rheinland.

## Our product range

## Fatty Alcohols

We offer mid and heavy cut fatty alcohols. Our manufacturing operations in Europe, Asia, and
Americas provide responsiveness and supply assurance across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][15]

## Fatty Acids

We offer a range of high purity short chain fatty acids, suitable for a wide range of applications
including MCTs (Medium-Chain Triglycerides), lubricants and agricultural chemical formulations.

[LEARN MORE][16]

## Glycerin

For over 160 years, we have produced high quality glycerin. Today our range includes USP and FCC
grade with GMP Certificate for Food (BRC, FSSC).

[LEARN MORE][17]

## Methyl Esters

Our portfolio of methyl esters includes a variety of broad and high purity cuts that can be supplied
across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][18]

## Get to know us

P&G Chemicals has been making products using naturally derived chemistry for over 160 years. We were
first established to deliver the high-quality ingredients and supply chains that Procter & Gamble
(our parent company) needed to develop our superior branded consumer products. Today our horizons
have broadened – so we serve not only P&G but leading chemical companies, in over 40 countries
across the globe, as a trusted supplier of naturally derived bio-solutions. 

[LEARN MORE][19]

## Sustainability

Our passion is to act as a catalyst for sustainable business growth – through responsibly sourced,
natural based low carbon products. With a global technical, manufacturing and supply chain network
based in North America, Europe and Asia, we think globally and act locally delivering quality,
reliablity and supply chain resilience.

Our products are designed with our impact, your impact and your customers needs in mind. We do this
by responsibly sourcing natural materials, creating products that enable our customers to reduce
their footprint and by driving positive impacts through partnerships and programs.

[LEARN MORE][20]

solar and energy brands in India.

solar panels and inverters to advanced energy storage systems and solar accessories. Backed by a
robust supply chain and technical expertise, the company provides tailored solutions for
residential, commercial, and industrial solar projects, ensuring quality assurance and after-sales
support across its entire product range.

## Prasol Chemicals Ltd. – Driving Chemistry, Empowering Progress

At **Prasol Chemicals Ltd.**, we are committed to excellence in chemical manufacturing, offering
high-quality **solvents, additives, and specialty chemicals** to industries worldwide. With a strong
foundation in **innovation, sustainability, and reliability**, we have established ourselves as a
trusted partner for businesses across **Home & Personal Care**, **Performance Chemicals**,
**Agrochemicals**, **Pharmaceutical** and **PICA** (Paints / Inks / Construction /
Adhesives) industries. 

Sustainability is at the heart of our operations. We prioritize **eco-friendly processes,
responsible sourcing, and waste reduction** to minimize our environmental footprint. By continuously
innovating and adopting sustainable practices, we aim to contribute to a greener future while
meeting the evolving needs of our customers. 

With a commitment to **quality, innovation, and sustainability**, **Prasol Chemicals Ltd.** is your
trusted partner for high-performance chemical solutions. Whether you’re looking for **reliable
supply chain support, advanced chemical formulations, or customized solutions**, we are here to help
you achieve success.

## A Legacy of Trust & Excellence

Founded in 1976 with just ₹300 and an unwavering belief, Reliable Chemicals Pune has grown into one
of India's most trusted chemical manufacturers and distributors.

From humble beginnings — manufacturing liquid soap in a single plastic drum — to a ₹100+ crore
enterprise serving over 6,000 industries, our journey is a testament to perseverance, quality, and
enduring relationships.

Today, with 5 manufacturing plants, 10 warehouses, and exports to 6+ countries, we continue to
deliver the same commitment our founders instilled five decades ago.

## specialty chemical manufacturers.

Rossari Biotech Limited is one of India's largest specialty chemical manufacturers, delivering
high-performance solutions that touch billions of lives daily. With over four decades of experience,
the company offers 4,300+ products to 3,000+ customers across 65+ countries. Operating seven
manufacturing facilities with 332,000+ MTPA capacity, Rossari Biotech serves diverse industries
including Textiles, Home Personal Care and Performance Chemicals, and Animal Health and Nutrition.
The company leads the market across four core chemistries: surfactants, polymers, silicones, and
enzymes. Committed to sustainability through green chemistry and zero-liquid-discharge facilities,
Rossari Biotech leverages its strong foundation and experienced leadership to shape the future of
specialty chemistry, creating lasting value for stakeholders worldwide.

# [Why Your Process Simulation Doesn't Match Plant Data (And What to Do About It) A practical guide
# to making your process simulations actually match reality ][24]

Ivana Lukec, Ph.D.
[Why Your Process Simulation Doesn't Match Plant Data (And What to Do About It)]

Your simulation converges beautifully, then the plant runs and nothing lines up. This happens
because of five compounding issues: wrong thermodynamics, bad boundary conditions, poor data
quality, missing controls, and unwritten operating rules. Here's a systematic calibration workflow
that takes models from 15% error down to under 5% - proven across dozens of projects in refineries,
chemical and other plants...

# Sun Chemical is the World’s Leading Provider of Inks and Pressroom Products, Color Materials and
# Advanced Materials

### Experience. Transformation.

Beginning with the inspiring legacy of Lorilleux and Samuel Morrill in the early 1800’s, Sun
Chemical has delivered [over 200 years][114] of color expertise, innovative technology and an
ongoing commitment to quality and service for our customers.

A member of the DIC Group, Sun Chemical is a leading producer of packaging and graphic solutions,
color and display technologies, functional products, electronic materials, and products for the
automotive and healthcare industries.

Together with DIC, Sun Chemical’s 21,000+ employees are continuously working to promote and develop
sustainable solutions to exceed customer expectations and better the world around us. Spread across
17 [research and development][115] centers worldwide, we’ve been granted over 3,000 patents and are
determined to deliver the solutions you need.


## Sun Chemical's Products and Solutions

#### [ Packaging and Graphic Solutions ][116]

Sun Chemical is a recognized leader in[ printing inks, coatings, adhesives and supplies][117] for
the packaging, publication, commercial, industrial, and digital markets and introduces solutions
that enable marketers to better manage their brand colors, protect product integrity through
improvements in packaging, and introduce security features that defend against counterfeiting.

# Sun Chemical is the World’s Leading Provider of Inks and Pressroom Products, Color Materials and
# Advanced Materials

### Experience. Transformation.

Beginning with the inspiring legacy of Lorilleux and Samuel Morrill in the early 1800’s, Sun
Chemical has delivered [over 200 years][114] of color expertise, innovative technology and an
ongoing commitment to quality and service for our customers.

A member of the DIC Group, Sun Chemical is a leading producer of packaging and graphic solutions,
color and display technologies, functional products, electronic materials, and products for the
automotive and healthcare industries.

Together with DIC, Sun Chemical’s 21,000+ employees are continuously working to promote and develop
sustainable solutions to exceed customer expectations and better the world around us. Spread across
17 [research and development][115] centers worldwide, we’ve been granted over 3,000 patents and are
determined to deliver the solutions you need.


## Sun Chemical's Products and Solutions

#### [ Packaging and Graphic Solutions ][116]

Sun Chemical is a recognized leader in[ printing inks, coatings, adhesives and supplies][117] for
the packaging, publication, commercial, industrial, and digital markets and introduces solutions
that enable marketers to better manage their brand colors, protect product integrity through
improvements in packaging, and introduce security features that defend against counterfeiting.

#### [ Color Materials ][118]

Sun Chemical develops a wide range of [pigments and color materials][119] for architectural,
automotive and industrial coatings, cosmetics, plastics, printing inks, agricultural, and more.
Combining its pigments with DIC’s polymers for the same industries can create superior benefits and
value for coatings formulators.

#### [ Advanced Materials ][120]

Sun Chemical and DIC produce a variety of [advanced materials][121], including liquid compounds,
solid compounds and application materials for printed circuits, printed electronics, solar modules,
digital inkjet printing, automotive components, adhesives, magnetic tapes for plastic cards and
degasification modules.

#### [ Sun Chemical Security ][122]

[Sun Chemical Security][123] is our dedicated global security solutions business unit focused on
providing a wide-range of high-quality security solutions to help protect your products from
counterfeiters.

## Sun Chemical's Unwavering Focus on Sustainability

#### Learn How Sun Chemical is Prioritizing Sustainability

Sun Chemical is constantly working to promote sustainable solutions. [Our approach][124] to
sustainability guides the way we develop, manufacture and distribute products, as well as how we
work with our customers and suppliers.

Working with industry leaders and in line with DIC Corporation’s goal to achieve [carbon neutrality
by 2050][125], we are reducing global CO2 emissions by increasing the use of bio-renewable and
recyclable materials, while promoting the value of these activities throughout the supply chain. Our
emphasis on sustainability continues to be fundamental to our innovation and product development and
is gaining broad support from our customers.

[ [SunChemical-Sustainability-Report-Covers] ][126]

#### [ Download Our Latest Sustainability Report ][127]

Every year we publish a [sustainability report][128] which shows our progress in achieving our
eco-efficiency goals and helps us establish actions to improve, recheck and remeasure.

## Economic Bioplastic to Finally beat Petrochemical Plastic.

At Sustainable Chemicals™, we are bringing novel bioplastics materials to market that will
revolutionize how bioplastics are adopted and used. Our ambitious goal is backed by economics and
superior performance, existing bioplastics can’t match, and will enable us to bring sustainable
bioplastics to producers and consumers in the plastics industry.

## **OUR MISSION IS TO SOLVE THE PLASTIC PROBLEM
## **

> *″Bioplastics have been around for decades, but the technology remains limited to niche
> applications because they have inferior properties and are more expensive than traditional
> plastics. The only way to achieve meaningful environmental change is to design a bioplastic that
> is cost and performance competitive with petroleum-based plastics. That is why I founded
> Sustainable Chemicals™.″*
> 
> **
> 
> * – Silvia Luebben, Sust-Chem CEO and Founder*
> 
> **
> 
> **
> 
> **

### Novel BioPlastics

We have novel bioplastics platform made from raw material obtained from biomass. This reduces the
carbon footprint of our product by 45% compared to petrochemical plastics.

### BioDegradation

If dispersed in the environment, Sust-Chem’s bioplastics degrade into benign molecules that can be
used by nature as building blocks.

If collected, our biopolymers can be chemically recycled.

### Cost-competitive

Petrochemical plastics are ubiquitous because they are convenient and cheap. Our chemistry does not
require fermentation compared to other bioplastics, which allows us to scale economically and become
cost-competitive with the petrochemical plastics.

### Actual Plastic Properties

Existing bioplastic products do not have a plastic look, feel, or application. Our bioplastics are
designed to have properties that match conventional petrochemical plastics to provide diverse
product applications.

## We Have the Power to Impact Our Future, and We’re Doing Something About It

 We are drowning in plastic pollution. 
* By the year 2050 there will be more plastic in the ocean than fish .
* Non-biodegradable plastics breakdown into smaller fragments, called microplastics, which enter our
  drinking water and food supply.  Each person consumes about half a pound of microplastics per
  year.
* Plastic manufacture and incineration accounts for 13% of global carbon dioxide emissions, a
  leading cause of global warming.
* Only 9% of plastic is actually recycled.
* Current alternatives to conventional polymers have made great technological advances, however
  their used is limited to niche applications because their cost is higher and their performance in
  inferior to that of conventional fossil fuel based plastics.

## OUR DUTY

## Bring to market a family of sustainable bioplastics that compete with petrochemical plastics in
## price and performance. 

## BIODEGRADABLE

Our material has a benign end of life whether it is recycled, up-cycled or lost to the environment.

[Learn More][6]

## RENEWABLE

The monomer is sourced from biomass which allows us to reduce the carbon footprint of our plastics
by 45%.

[Learn More][7]

## NONPERSISTANT

Our plastic breaks down into benign materials if improperly disposed.

[Learn More][8]

## NONTOXIC

The monomer is present in soy sauce and has a natural metabolic pathway.

[Learn More][9]

## PROPERTIES

Mechanical properties of our biopolymer match conventional plastics.

[Learn More][10]

At Sustainable Chemicals™, we are bringing novel bioplastics materials to market that will
revolutionize how bioplastics are adopted and used. Our ambitious goal is backed by economics and
superior performance, existing bioplastics can’t match, and will enable us to bring sustainable
bioplastics to producers and consumers in the plastics industry.

## **OUR MISSION IS TO SOLVE THE PLASTIC PROBLEM
## **

> *″Bioplastics have been around for decades, but the technology remains limited to niche
> applications because they have inferior properties and are more expensive than traditional
> plastics. The only way to achieve meaningful environmental change is to design a bioplastic that
> is cost and performance competitive with petroleum-based plastics. That is why I founded
> Sustainable Chemicals™.″*
> 
> **
> 
> * – Silvia Luebben, Sust-Chem CEO and Founder*
> 
> **
> 
> **
> 
> **

### Novel BioPlastics

We have novel bioplastics platform made from raw material obtained from biomass. This reduces the
carbon footprint of our product by 45% compared to petrochemical plastics.

### BioDegradation

If dispersed in the environment, Sust-Chem’s bioplastics degrade into benign molecules that can be
used by nature as building blocks.

If collected, our biopolymers can be chemically recycled.

### Cost-competitive

Petrochemical plastics are ubiquitous because they are convenient and cheap. Our chemistry does not
require fermentation compared to other bioplastics, which allows us to scale economically and become
cost-competitive with the petrochemical plastics.

### Actual Plastic Properties

Existing bioplastic products do not have a plastic look, feel, or application. Our bioplastics are
designed to have properties that match conventional petrochemical plastics to provide diverse
product applications.

## We Have the Power to Impact Our Future, and We’re Doing Something About It

 We are drowning in plastic pollution. 
* By the year 2050 there will be more plastic in the ocean than fish .
* Non-biodegradable plastics breakdown into smaller fragments, called microplastics, which enter our
  drinking water and food supply.  Each person consumes about half a pound of microplastics per
  year.
* Plastic manufacture and incineration accounts for 13% of global carbon dioxide emissions, a
  leading cause of global warming.
* Only 9% of plastic is actually recycled.
* Current alternatives to conventional polymers have made great technological advances, however
  their used is limited to niche applications because their cost is higher and their performance in
  inferior to that of conventional fossil fuel based plastics.

## OUR DUTY

## Bring to market a family of sustainable bioplastics that compete with petrochemical plastics in
## price and performance. 

## BIODEGRADABLE

Our material has a benign end of life whether it is recycled, up-cycled or lost to the environment.

[Learn More][6]

## RENEWABLE

The monomer is sourced from biomass which allows us to reduce the carbon footprint of our plastics
by 45%.

[Learn More][7]

## NONPERSISTANT

Our plastic breaks down into benign materials if improperly disposed.

[Learn More][8]

## NONTOXIC

The monomer is present in soy sauce and has a natural metabolic pathway.

[Learn More][9]

## PROPERTIES

Mechanical properties of our biopolymer match conventional plastics.

[Learn More][10]

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

# Buy-Side Advisory for Renewable Energy & Climate Tech

## We advise private equity, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, hedge funds, and board-level
## sponsors on asset-grade due diligence — including renewable energy due diligence and climate tech
## due diligence — capital deployment, and IRR-linked execution across renewable fuels, low-carbon
## molecules, and energy-transition platforms.

[Speak with a Principal][9]

New investments • Existing asset optimization • Value-at-risk assessment • Scale-up feasibility

### $3B+

Assets Advised

in renewable & climate-tech assets advised or underwritten

### 6

US & PCT Patents

across waste-to-energy and advanced biofuels pathways

### 250M+

Gallons 

of renewable fuels produced under prior operating mandates

### 15-30%

EBITDA Uplifts

on turnaround assets in renewable energy & biofuels

## EXECUTIVE THESIS

### SAF & E-Fuels: The Feedstock & Pathway Edge

Multi-pathway configurations (HEFA, AtJ, FT, PtL) with feedstock optionality can potentially
out-compete single-pathway plants on margin resilience – not just capacity expansion alone 

### BECCS at Biorefineries: Double-Stacked Returns 

Fermentation CO₂ capture can stack 45Q + 45Z credits into a defensible cash engine that fully
integrated operators can execute at scale.

### Fuel Cells: Bridging the Datacenter Power Gap

48E-backed fuel-cells can cut short multi-year grid interconnection delays for hyperscalers, turning
uptime guarantees into premium-rate offtake. 

### Green H₂: Right-Sized, Bankable, Built by 2027

Compressed 45V timelines under OBBBA make megaprojects risky — but power-advantaged, co-located
H₂→NH₃/MeOH assets still pencil strong IRR in the right niches.

### Emerging Watchlist

Geothermal Baseload for AI & Industry — Resource-proven basins within fiber reach are gaining
offtake attention as wind/solar timelines tighten.

## CONNECTED VALUE CHAIN

Our mandates span the linked value chain where feedstock economics, process technology, capital
architecture, and exit pathways determine value.

Feedstock Origination

UCO, tallow, biomass residues, MSW — margin lives in CI, price, and logistics.   


→  [renewable diesel strategy advisory][10]

Conversion Technologies

Fischer Tropsch, Gasification, Alcohol to Jet—fit-for-scale depend on CI, uptime and TRL. 


→ [e-fuels / power-to-liquids advisory][11]

Product Design & Offtake

SAF, RD, green H₂, green methanol, platform chemicals—contract quality and premia defend IRR.

 

→ [sustainable aviation fuel project advisory][12]

Capital, Credits & Exit Strategy

45Z, LCFS, RINs, tax equity, roll-ups—value sits in stack design and exit timing. 


→ [capital structure & exit strategy advisory][13]

## VALUE IN ACTION

### Power To Liquid (PtL)

De-risked $200M+ investment for sovereign wealth fund via full techno-commercial validation for
e-fuels & biomaterials 

### Biomass & Municipal Solid Waste (MSW)to Synfuels 

Assessed technology maturity, IRR sensitivity & bankability for early-stage VC bet

### Cellulosic Biofuels & Green Hydrocarbons

Guided European PE firm through market sizing, platform potential & IRR calibration

### Renewable Diesel (RD) & Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF)

Designed investment strategy for capital-efficient entry, margin structures, incentive stacking &
market prioritization

## CORE SERVICES

### Opportunity Origination

Tailored Solutions

Surfacing under‑market or overlooked assets across SAF, Renewable Diesel, E‑Fuels and Platform
Chemicals via proprietary sector scans, policy arbitrage, feedstock economics, and real‑world
readiness signals.

### Transaction-Grade Due Diligence

Expert Guidance

IC-ready technical, commercial, and policy due diligence for investments, JV, and strategic stakes —
integrating financial models with operational risk assessment.


→ [transaction-grade due diligence][14]

### Technology De-Risking

Commercialization

Validating frontier technologies across energy storage, green hydrocarbons, advanced biofuels,
platform chemicals, carbon sequestration, waste conversion & recycling for scalability, market fit,
value capture and bankable offtake. 

### Portfolio Resilience 

Market Positioning

Multi-pathway production, credit optimization (LCFS, RED III, CORSIA), credible offtake stacks and
feedstock diversification — protecting IRR and FCF through policy cycles and commodity swings.

### Time-to-Value Compression

Tailored Solutions

Shortening the period from capital allocation to positive cash flow by fast-tracking critical
decision points with structured execution frameworks.

### Performance Optimization

Asset Conversion

Transforming idle or distressed assets into competitive operations, improving EBITDA & IRR through
debottlenecking, OPEX reduction or yield optimization top of page

## Scaling to commercial production of acrylonitrile from glycerol.

### Green technology. Secure supply chain.

Trillium Renewable Chemicals is replacing oil and gas derived propylene with biorenewable feedstocks
in the manufacturing of green, drop-in molecules like acrylonitrile and acetonitrile. As the
worldwide demand for these chemicals increase, we’re providing a green alternative that reduces
carbon emissions, improves safety, and offers customers less volatile, competitive economics. We’re
the leader in green acrylonitrile technology. We’re ready to grow and put our customers on the path
to sustainability.

### Find the Materials You Need

The UL Prospector materials database helps you find plastics, chemicals and ingredients for your
next formulation and product development challenge. Product formulators, engineers, and developers
can locate technical data on hundreds of thousands of products in one easy-to-use search engine.

Create your free account to:
* Find materials, technical information and suppliers quickly and easily
* Search by material type, supplier, application, or functionality
* Stay informed with industry trends and information

Beyond materials search, Prospector also has starter formulations to accelerate your product
development. You can request samples from multiple suppliers within your Prospector account for
simple order organization. All product listings include the supplying company’s contact information
for quick communication.

Access is free to qualified professionals. Simply complete the registration form to start finding
materials.

[Create Your Free Account Now][37] [ Learn more][38]

### Prospector offers additional services for select industries including:
* #### Retailer and Regulatory Compliance Highlights
  
  Analyze ingredient-level compliance information within Prospector for more than 200 global
  regulatory and advisory lists and 30 international retailer lists.
* #### Enhanced search functionality
  
  Utilize side-by-side comparisons, UL Yellow Card performance information, OEM/automotive approved
  materials, find alternative resins and more advanced search techniques.
* #### Visual data representation
  
  View curve multipoint data for performance characteristics, compare properties on a radar plot or
  explore material features plotted graphically.

[Market with Supplier Pages, catalog listing, webinars and more]

### Marketing Solutions for Suppliers

Help product developers, engineers, and chemical buyers find your products. With UL's marketing
solutions for suppliers you can connect with Prospector members around the world. [Learn More][39]

###### Custom Specialty Chemical Manufacturing

# VanDeMark — Phosgene Derivatives & Other Specialty Chemicals

Trusted by industry leaders for our unwavering commitment to safety, innovation, and manufacturing
excellence, VanDeMark delivers precision-engineered specialty chemicals. For more than 70 years,
we’ve provided unequaled expertise in custom phosgene derivatives and complex chemical
manufacturing.

[Contact Us][30]

#### [Synthesis Capabilities][31]

From phosgenation and chlorination to hydrazine, acylation, and esterification, our team has the
synthesis capabilities and experience to address your requirements.

#### [Process Capabilities][32]

Our process capabilities include batch synthesis, liquid and solids handling, and distillation
services to meet your requirements

#### [R&D][33]

VanDeMark offers unique capabilities in the development and commercialization of phosgene-based
products and additional complex chemistries.

#### [Plant Scale Production][34]

We are flexible in terms of product quantities, adding new material to existing product families,
and in meeting unique and specialized needs of our customers.

###### Products

## Tailored Custom Chemical Manufacturing

VanDeMark provides a wide range of chemical intermediates based on phosgene and associated
chemistries that are utilized in highly demanding applications. We develop customized solutions
addressing specific customer requirements across a variety of markets.

Since 1951, VanDeMark has excelled in supplying the materials and life sciences markets with
products based on phosgene and associated complex chemistries. We safely transform complex chemicals
into essential ingredients for our customers’ products, which help improve and protect lives.
Safety, quality, service, and sustainability are key to how we operate.

[Learn More][36]

###### Markets

## Industry Expertise in Phosgene Derivatives, and More

VanDeMark is a trusted, long-tenured supplier to many top-tier companies. We serve a diverse
end-market mix with significant exposure in the material, life sciences, and consumer markets.

# Vertec BioSolvents

## Bio-Based Green Solvents for formulating and cleaning.

[ KNOW WHAT YOU NEED? ][16]

An innovative manufacturer of sustainable, safe, bio-based green solvents and solvent blends derived
from corn, soybeans, citrus and other renewable feedstocks.

## Check Out Our Resin Compatibility Studies for CASE Industries!

The CASE (Coating, Adhesives, Sealants, and Elastomers) industries are experiencing an evolution in
new product formulations. The need for environmentally friendly products has never been higher.
Consumers and businesses are demanding sustainable products and a reduction of environmental impact
from the CASE industries.



Learn more about our six different CASE studies on Acrylic Polymers, Polyester Polymers, Epoxy
Resins, Isocyanate Resins, Polyamide Polymers, and Melamine Polymers!

[ Read Case Studies ][17]

### Technology

Our technology and people create value in our products and applications.

[LEARN MORE][18]

### Innovation

We achieved major breakthrough in lactate ester technology, expanding potential for further
application of bio-based solvents as replacement for petrochemical solvents.

[LEARN MORE][19]

### Sustainability

We create bio-based solvents designed to outperform their petrochemical counterparts.

[LEARN MORE][20]

### Applications

Vertec BioSolvents has multiple issued patents in solvent blends and applications.

[LEARN MORE][21]

## Want to try our products?

[ REQUEST A SAMPLE ][22]

## Who Uses Vertec BioSolvents?

## Products for **
## **Your Industry.

### Agriculture

Our BioSolvents can be used to safely improve agricultural growing environments. They are used for
the formulation of environmentally friendly herbicides, pesticides, and growth enhancers. Our
bio-based agricultural products include:
* EPA approved 4A Inert Solvents, VertecBio™ EL Ethyl Lactate and VertecBio™ BL Butyl Lactate
* VertecBio™ Citrus
* VertecBio Gold®
* VertecBio™ AG Blend EL-104

### Cleaning Products

Industrial cleaning requires targeted solvents for specific cleaning requirements.  VertecBio™
solvent blends are designed to clean, dissolve, or sanitize, whether used directly or as part of
your own formulation.

### Coatings & Paints

We create biosolvents that are a highly effective and environmentally friendly method for paint gun
and line flush cleanings. They serve as effective high-solid, Hazardous Air Pollutant (HAP) free
"green" coatings. Our bio-based products for coatings and paints include:
* VertecBio™ ELSOL® blends for high performance, low odor coatings and formations
* VertecBio™ Citrus for top-rated, no HAPs paint gun and line flush cleaning.
* ﻿VertecBio™ EL 

### Other Industries

Wherever petroleum solvents are used, there is a safer biobased, renewable resource alternative
available from Vertec BioSolvents. Your creativity makes the possibilities endless.

## Our Product Line

Our EL products offer a 100 percent biodegradable way to cut through paints, coatings and inks.

[ LEARN MORE ][23]

The VertecBio Gold® product line is ideal for paint strippers, graffiti removers, heavy asphalt
cleaners and degreasers.

[ LEARN MORE ][24]
[Green Solvents derived from corn and other sustainable products]
[ VIEW ENTIRE PRODUCT LINE ][25]

Our ELSOL products serve as drop-in replacements for existing petroleum-based solvents.

[ LEARN MORE ][26]

VertecBio™ Citrus family of products are excellent cleaners for epoxy, polyurethane and other
resins.

[ LEARN MORE ][27]

# Better chemistry for a healthier planet

By restricting hazardous chemical input and adopting sustainable chemical management practices,
clean input can be delivered in any industry.
The ZDHC Manufacturing Restricted Substances List (MRSL) helps industries clearly communicate,
within a unified requirement, chemicals that are harmful and work on eliminating these from supply
chains.

## At ZDHC we believe the MRSL is the answer

From automotive to electronics, home goods to packaging, every sector that relies on chemicals has a
role to play. The ZDHC MRSL offers a ready-made, globally recognised framework to phase out harmful
substances at the source. It’s practical, science-based, and designed for real-world implementation.
The ZDHC MRSL helps you reduce risk, stay ahead of regulation, and future-proof your business while
protecting the environment. 

Why start from scratch, when the solution already exists?

[Learn more about MRSL][7]

## ZDHC Impact Areas

Water Stewardship

Clean water starts with better chemistry. Every drop protected through safer choices.

Biodiversity

Protecting nature’s balance through safer chemistry. Preserving ecosystems one chemical decision at
a time.

Circularity

Safe materials, endless possibilities. Creating tomorrow’s resources through today’s responsible
choices.

Greenhouse Gas Emissions

Climate-smart chemistry for a cooler planet. Reducing our carbon footprint with every formulation.

## Pioneering industry
## since 2015

In 2011, the 'Detox My Fashion' campaign sparked a movement that eliminated toxic wastewater,
engaged over 350 industry signatories, and created the Sustainable Chemical Management Framework.

# Better chemistry for a healthier planet

By restricting hazardous chemical input and adopting sustainable chemical management practices,
clean input can be delivered in any industry.
The ZDHC Manufacturing Restricted Substances List (MRSL) helps industries clearly communicate,
within a unified requirement, chemicals that are harmful and work on eliminating these from supply
chains.

## At ZDHC we believe the MRSL is the answer

From automotive to electronics, home goods to packaging, every sector that relies on chemicals has a
role to play. The ZDHC MRSL offers a ready-made, globally recognised framework to phase out harmful
substances at the source. It’s practical, science-based, and designed for real-world implementation.
The ZDHC MRSL helps you reduce risk, stay ahead of regulation, and future-proof your business while
protecting the environment. 

Why start from scratch, when the solution already exists?

### High performance plant-based ingredients for the products that touch our lives every day.

[ Explore our award winning Citropol® products for beauty ][31]

## P2 is Powered by
## Green Chemistry

## P2 Science is a technology company transforming nature’s building blocks into powerful chemistry
## in a completely new way using the 12 Principles of Green Chemistry.
## 
## We are taking the harmful chemicals out of consumer goods and replacing them with safer,
## high-performance ingredients accessible to all. Reducing dependence on fossil-based raw materials
## by sourcing abundant plant-based inputs is core to our mission.

## Our Industries

[Beauty & Personal Care][32]

[Feel Good Beauty Starts Here][33]

[Aroma Technologies][34]

[Unlocking New Aroma Experiences][35]

[Performance Materials][36]

[Crop Care][38]

[Harnessing Natural Systems][39]

## What is Green Chemistry?

Green Chemistry is the foundation of everything P2 does - from developing new reactor technologies
and high-performance liquid polymers, to breaking down barriers for planet-safe products in
industries that affect everyday life.

By designing with the 12 Principles of Green Chemistry in mind, P2 is making sustainability
accessible, scalable, and efficient from start to finish.

[ Learn more ][40]

P2 is a recognized innovator for high performance natural polymers

Fast Company magazine recognized P2 as one of its Most Innovative Companies for a second consecutive
year, ranking #2 in the beauty category for Citropol^{®} F - the groundbreaking fragrance enhancer
that represents the next step in fragrance performance.

[ All Awards & Achievements ][41]

## We Are P2 Science

P2 Science was started by two scientists from Yale University, who were disheartened by the
widespread use of non-sustainable, synthetic compounds found in everyday use. P2 Science started
with a simple vision - develop high performance, innovative ingredients that align with planetary
health.

Holding to the 12 Principles of Green Chemistry, over the past 14 years, P2 Science has become a
global leader in bringing naturally derived, sustainable ingredients to market; partnering with
brands and manufacturers in 25 countries.

### **Announcing 2026 In-Person Events**

**Your learning and relationships should grow all year long — and now, they will!**

Starting in 2026, ACD Regional Meetings will follow a new seasonal schedule, with meetings held in
the Winter, Spring, and Fall, rotating to different cities each year to make participation more
accessible for members nationwide. Alongside these enhanced Regionals, we are also excited to share
the confirmed dates and locations for ChemEdge, the Washington Fly-In, and the 2026 Annual Meeting.

Whether you are building new connections, strengthening your team’s capabilities, or tackling
industry challenges together, ACD events bring our community closer, wherever you are.

**More details on each event will be available soon. We look forward to seeing you there.**

asked our members to share data on their work, the size of their business, and the logistics
involved in safely delivering the chemical products essential to everyday life.

matters.

storage. Our state-of-the-art technology, high uptime, and our ability to provide the most
competitive tariffs are some USPs that set us apart in the industry.

# Speeding up your biobased innovation

## A unique, flexible, multi-purpose state-of-the-art pilot facility for the bioeconomy

#### Process development, scale-up and custom manufacturing of innovative biobased products and
#### processes.

Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant is an independent, state-of-the-art facility that operates from
a laboratory level to a multi-ton scale. Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant is a service provider
for process development, scale-up and custom manufacturing of biobased products and processes. A
wide and flexible spectrum of modular unit operations combined with the experience of our highly
competent engineers and technicians enables us to translate your biobased lab protocol into a viable
industrial process.

Bio Base Europe Pilot Plant enables the conversion of renewable feedstocks into biochemicals,
biomaterials, biofuels and other bioproducts by using technologies such as biomass pretreatment,
biocatalysis, precision fermentation (up to 75,000 L), biomass fermentation (up to 75,000 L), gas
fermentation, green chemistry and product recovery and purification (downstream processing).

  Environmental     Ocean-Recycling     Animal-Protection     Renewable-Energy  

## We Are Pioneers In The World Of Solar & Renewable Energy!

We are a dedicated biogas and renewable energy consulting firm committed to helping industries,
farmers, and entrepreneurs build a sustainable future. Our expertise lies in **biogas plant
consultancy**, **CBG project planning**, and **waste-to-energy solutions** tailored for India’s
unique needs

Whether you are looking to set up a small-scale biogas unit or a commercial compressed biogas (CBG)
plant, we provide **end-to-end support** — from feasibility to implementation.

We assist with approvals, subsidies, and technical support to streamline your project. Our goal is
to ensure smooth execution and lasting impact.

[ Learn More ][58]

We enable the shift to sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy through expert consulting and
innovation.

We provide expert consulting for biogas projects, helping clients turn organic waste into clean,
renewable energy. From planning to implementation, we ensure efficient and sustainable solutions.

[ Learn More ][59]

## Biomass

We provide expert consulting for biomass projects, helping clients turn organic waste into clean,
renewable energy. From planning to implementation, we ensure efficient and sustainable solutions.

[ Learn More ][60]

efficient, cost-effective, and sustainable solar power systems tailored to their needs.

[ Learn More ][61]

requirements and goals.

## Cost Savings

By adopting efficient energy solutions, you can significantly reduce your energy bills while
maximizing long-term savings.

We ensure that your energy projects comply with the latest industry regulations and standards,
mitigating any legal or environmental risks.

manufacture. The packaging can also be customized.

the food industry.

anywhere in the world.

INTEGRATED BIO-CHEMICAL MANUFACTURING

# Where biology meets
# chemistry.
# *At scale.*

One integrated platform for the industrialized production of bio-based chemicals - engineered for
performance, cost efficiency, and sovereignty. 

[ Explore the platform ][11]

THE PROBLEM

### The way we manufacture chemicals needs *an upgrade* 

Today, biology and chemistry are built in silos *–* two powerful disciplines disconnected 

**Chemical manufacturing is fragile
and unsustainable** 

Scalable – but built on petroleum and concentrated oleochemical supply chains, it faces
sustainability pressure and geopolitical risk. 

**Biomanufacturing has a narrow
product scope ** 

Local, renewable feedstocks and sustainable production - but comes with a limited product range and
long development timelines 

OUR FOUNDATION

### We leverage the best of both disciplines,
### *built as one.*  

Biology delivers sustainable platform molecules locally, chemistry multiplies the product scope and
scales output. A single, integrated continuous manufacturing process from renewable feedstocks to
finished product.  

**Resilient
**local, diversified feedstocks 

**Sustainable
**biological production from renewable sources  

**Scalable & versatile
**chemical diversification without reinventing biology each time

## Next-generation bio-based chemical manufacturing *starts here.*

[ Get in touch ][12]

OUR APPROACH

### One process.
### Biology and chemistry, *engineered together.*

BioTreasure integrates circular continuous precision fermentation with proprietary chemistry into
one modular manufacturing system.

**01**

**Renewable Feedstocks**

Domestic, flexible sourcing from renewable carbon inputs

**02**

**Circular Continuous Fermentation**

Precision fermentation for circular continuous industrial operation

**03**

**Integrated Proprietary Chemistry**

Chemical routes co-designed with upstream biology

**Bio-Based Chemicals **

Multiple industries – one modular platform
* [Advanced Materials]
  
  ## Advanced Materials
  
  Bio-based building blocks for high-performance polymers and advanced material systems securing
  domestic supply.
* [Personal & Home Care Upcycled, bio-based specialty ingredients that reduce dependence on volatile
  tropical oil and petrochemical supply chains.]
  
  ## Personal & Home Care
  
  Upcycled, bio-based specialty ingredients that reduce dependence on volatile tropical oil and
  petrochemical supply chains.
* [Agrochemicals]
  
  ## Agrochemicals
  
  Essential, bio-based crop solutions strengthening domestic agricultural resilience

[ Get in touch ][13]

THE ADVANTAGE

### The bio-based chemical manufacturing platform
### *built to scale.*

We engineer biology and chemistry as a single, integrated platform, so every new molecule builds on
shared process design, enabling faster scale-up and continuously improving unit economics.

**Proprietary biology**

Efficient biological conversion of renewable feedstocks via continuous fermentation.

**Integrated chemistry**

Optimized chemical transformation routes built for direct integration with fermentation.  

**Co-designed process**

Bio and chemical processes developed together – not handed off between teams.  

**Modular architecture**

Shared manufacturing
modules enable cross-
product efficiencies and economies of scale. 

**Industrial scale**

Engineered from the outset
for efficient, industrial-scale operation. 

**Infrastructure compatible ** 

Engineered to work within
existing manufacturing
facilities.

## Join Us

Driven by curiosity and built on purpose, this is where bold thinking meets technical rigor and
relentless execution.

Let’s build something meaningful together.

[ see open positions ][14]

February 24, 2026

BioTreasure, backed by SPRIND and leveraging Insempra's industrial biotechnology platform, has
advanced to Stage III of SPRIND's Circular Biomanufacturing Challenge, securing €2.5 million to
scale its integrated bio-chemical manufacturing platform toward industrial deployment and
commercialization.

[ Read more ][15]

Bio-based building blocks for advanced materials, agrochemicals, and specialty ingredients for
personal and home care - as drop-in solutions or co-developed with you.

# Color Meanings – Discover the Power and Symbolism Behind Every Hue

[Color Meanings]

Colors play an exceptionally prominent role in our lives. They influence our thinking, inspire our
decision-making, and impact our moods. From causing changes to changing reactions, colors are more
powerful than we think. Depending on our interpretations, they can be used for both good and evil.
Fortunately, we have the power to welcome some colors and shun others. This guide will take you on a
journey through the exciting universe of color meanings.

It’s important to note that not all colors were created equal. Though some shades are similar, that
doesn’t mean they’ll awaken the same emotions. To truly grasp the meaning of color, we must learn to
accept this. It’s also imperative to relinquish some control. Try as we might, we won’t always have
a handle on our emotions. Colors have such a substantial effect on the mind and body, and until we
make our peace with this reality, we’ll remain forever perplexed by inexplicable and random
reactions.

**You can read about each color meaning by clicking the links below:**
1.  [Red][26]
2.  [Orange][27]
3.  [Yellow][28]
4.  [Green][29]
5.  [Turquoise][30]
6.  [Blue][31]
7.  [Purple][32]
8.  [Pink][33]
9.  [Brown][34]
10. [Black][35]
11. [Gray][36]
12. [White][37]

## Recognizing Your Responses

Have you ever noticed a shift in your attitude while surrounded by a particular color? Perhaps
you’ve been overwhelmed with nostalgia while staring at a specific shade. You’ve likely written
these occurrences off as a common human response, but the cause is far more complex than that. Color
psychology teaches us that much of human behavior is dictated by color. When we open our minds to
this possibility, we begin to understand the scope of our perceptions.

## Personal Cognizance

Once we acknowledge that colors influence doings, it makes way for personal interpretations. In
other words, we level the playing field by regaining some control of how we react to colors. You may
realize that the color red triggers anger. To avoid unnecessary bouts of rage, limit your encounters
with this hue. On the other hand, yellow might make you feel cheery and upbeat. If so, introduce
more of this color into your life. With a healthy dose of awareness, you can somewhat manage the
moods and emotions that colors produce.

## Uncovering New Meanings

The psychology behind color is fascinating and ever-expanding. With that said, new meanings are
always coming to light. The more knowledge we acquire, the more informed we become. This prospect
promises great hope for future research.

What’s more, our minds are in a perpetual state of evolvement. In essence, though some colors have
fixed explanations, these findings can always shift. This fact is both unsettling and reassuring. As
researchers continue to delve into the many facets of the color wheel, new information is
continually revealing itself.

## Diversify Your Understandings

While reading these articles, you’ll develop a deeper understanding of what colors mean, how they
make an impression on us, and the ways we perceive them. The notion that colors are so dynamic may
seem absurd to some, but there’s no refuting this truth. This concept often eludes us because we
don’t realize how frequently colors control us. Certain hues can evoke fond memories. Others may
give rise to dreadful feelings.

## An Overview of Color Meanings

To help you discover the celebrated phenomenon of colors, here’s an overview of each color’s
meaning, what it symbolizes, and how it affects human emotion and behavior.

### 1. Red Color Meaning

[[Red Color Meaning Infographic][Red Color Meaning Infographic]][38]

The color of passion and energy. Red draws attention like no other color and radiates a strong and
powerful energy that motivates us to take action. It is also linked to sexuality and stimulates deep
and intimate passion. Red is ubiquitously used to warn and signal caution and danger.

[Read more about the color red][39]

### 2. Orange Color Meaning

[[Orange Color Meaning Infographic][Orange Color Meaning Infographic]][40]

The color of enthusiasm and emotion. Orange exudes warmth and joy and is considered a fun color that
provides emotional strength. It is optimistic and upliftning, adds spontaneity and positivity to
life and it encourages social communication and creativity. It is a youthful and energetic color.

make our peace with this reality, we’ll remain forever perplexed by inexplicable and random
reactions.
